         171	def _setup_gpu_tensors(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, device, mass, atol, dt, seed=42,
         172	                       verbose=False):
         173	    """在指定设备上生成规范场/Clover 项/源（C++ 后端）。
         174
         175	    返回 (g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa)。
         176	    """
         177	    params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         178	    params_t[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0
         179	    params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         180	    params_t[define._DAGGER_] = 0
         181	    params_t[define._MAX_ITER_] = 1000
         182	    params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 1 if verbose else 0
         183	    params_t[define._SEED_] = seed
         184	    params_t[define._TEST_IN_CPU_] = 0
         185	    av = argv_t.to(dtype=define.dtype(define.epytd(dt)).to_real())
         186	    av[define._MASS_] = mass
         187	    av[define._ATOL_] = atol
         188	    av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         189	    ls = define.lat_shape(params_t)
         190	    # P100(sm_60) 兼容：torch 2.10 无 sm_60 kernel image，zeros/randn 填充内核
         191	    # 在 P100 上失败并污染 CUDA 错误状态；empty（纯 cudaMalloc）与 CPU 生成 +
         192	    # H2D 拷贝（driver memcpy）均可用。C++ 后端会写满 g/ce/coo 等输出缓冲。
         193	    g = torch.empty([2, 3, 3, 4] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         194	    fi = torch.randn([2, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device='cpu').to(device)
         195	    ce = torch.empty([4, 3, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         196	    cei = torch.empty_like(ce); coo = torch.empty_like(ce); coi = torch.empty_like(ce)
         197	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = -1
         198	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyGaussGaugeQcu(g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         199	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         200	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(ce, cei, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         201	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 1
         202	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(coo, coi, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         203	    U_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g)
         204	    b_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(fi)
         205	    kappa = 1.0 / (2 * mass + 8)
         206	    clover_full = dslash.make_clover(U_full, kappa=kappa)
         207	    return g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa, av

         210	class MultiGpuMultigrid(object):
         211	    """多线程多卡 C++ Clover Multigrid 驱动（一线程一卡）。
         212
         213	    构造参数：
         214	        lat_size: [Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt]
         215	        mass / atol: 求解质量参数与容差
         216	        num_levels / dof_list / mg_grid / num_restart / coarse_max_iter /
         217	        coarse_tol_factor / nv_iters: 粗网格配置（同 conftest.schur.multigrid）
         218	        nthreads: 线程数（默认 = 设备数）
         219	        device_ids: 显式设备 id 列表（默认 range(可见设备数)；
         220	            线程 tid 绑定 device_ids[tid % len(device_ids)]）
         221	        use_cache / cache_dir: 粗网格算子 h5py 缓存
         222	        verbose: 详细输出
         223
         224	    方法：
         225	        solve(): 并行求解（每线程一个完整 MG 流程），返回结果字典
         226	        verify_consistency(tol): 线程间解与主线程参考解的一致性校验
         227	    """
         228
         229	    def __init__(self, lat_size=None, mass=0.05, atol=1e-6, num_levels=2,
         230	                 dof_list=None, mg_grid=None, num_restart=5, coarse_max_iter=15,
         231	                 coarse_tol_factor=1e5, nv_iters=2, nthreads=None, device_ids=None,
         232	                 use_cache=True, cache_dir=None, verbose=True,
         233	                 independent_problems=False):
         234	        from mpi4py import MPI
         235	        # C++ LatticeSet::init 用 MPI_COMM_WORLD 真实 rank 覆盖 _NODE_RANK_，
         236	        # 多线程独立实例语义要求单 rank（多进程分布走每进程单线程实例路径）。
         237	        if MPI.COMM_WORLD.Get_size() > 1:
         238	            raise RuntimeError(
         239	                "PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n MultiGpuMultigrid requires a single "
         240	                "MPI rank (mpirun -np 1): multi-process distribution uses "
         241	                "per-rank single-thread instances; multi-GPU parallelism inside "
         242	                "one process uses one-thread-one-GPU.")
         243	        if lat_size is None:
         244	            lat_size = [8, 8, 8, 16]
         245	        if mg_grid is None:
         246	            mg_grid = [2, 2, 2, 2]
         247	        self.lat_size = list(lat_size)
         248	        self.mass = mass
         249	        self.atol = atol
         250	        self.num_levels = num_levels
         251	        if dof_list is None:
         252	            dof_list = [12, 48, 48, 48, 48]
         253	        self.dof_list = dof_list[:num_levels]
         254	        self.mg_grid = mg_grid
         255	        self.num_restart = num_restart
         256	        self.coarse_max_iter = coarse_max_iter
         257	        self.coarse_tol_factor = coarse_tol_factor
         258	        self.nv_iters = nv_iters
         259	        self.verbose = verbose
         260	        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
         261	        self.use_cache = use_cache
         262	        num_gpus = torch.cuda.device_count() if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0
         263	        if num_gpus == 0:
         264	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n no CUDA device available")
         265	        if device_ids is None:
         266	            device_ids = list(range(num_gpus))
         267	        self.device_ids = [int(d) for d in device_ids]
         268	        if nthreads is None:
         269	            nthreads = len(self.device_ids)
         270	        self.nthreads = nthreads
         271	        self.dt = torch.complex64
         272	        self.independent_problems = independent_problems
         273	        self._results = None
         274
         275	    def _build_coarse_ops(self, S, E, device):
         276	        """主线程构建 Schur 粗网格算子（h5py 缓存）。"""
         277	        return build_schur_levels(
         278	            op=None, S=S, num_levels=self.num_levels, dof_list=self.dof_list,
         279	            mg_grid=self.mg_grid, lat_full=self.lat_size, E=E, dt=self.dt,
         280	            device=device, nv_iters=self.nv_iters, use_cache=self.use_cache,
         281	            cache_dir=self.cache_dir, verbose=self.verbose)
         282
         283	    def _config_params(self, params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, av):
         284	        Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt = self.lat_size
         285	        params_t[define._LAT_X_] = Lx; params_t[define._LAT_Y_] = Ly
         286	        params_t[define._LAT_Z_] = Lz; params_t[define._LAT_T_] = Lt
         287	        params_t[define._LAT_XYZT_] = Lx * Ly * Lz * Lt
         288	        # 每线程/每进程独立完整实例：单 rank 网格（无 MPI 分布 halo），
         289	        # 多卡并行通过线程×卡绑定实现，不依赖 MPI 通信。
         290	        params_t[define._GRID_X_], params_t[define._GRID_Y_], \
         291	            params_t[define._GRID_Z_], params_t[define._GRID_T_] = 1, 1, 1, 1
         292	        params_t[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0
         293	        params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         294	        params_t[define._DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         295	        # mass/atol/sigma 必须显式设置（模块级 argv 默认 mass=-3.5 会奇异）
         296	        av[define._MASS_] = self.mass
         297	        av[define._ATOL_] = self.atol
         298	        av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         299	        params_t[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = self.num_levels
         300	        if self.num_levels >= 2:
         301	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_E_] = self.dof_list[1]
         302	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Lx // self.mg_grid[0]
         303	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Ly // self.mg_grid[1]
         304	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Lz // self.mg_grid[2]
         305	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Lt // (2 * self.mg_grid[3])
         306	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_MAX_ITER_] = self.coarse_max_iter
         307	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         308	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_NUM_RESTART_] = self.num_restart
         309	        if self.num_levels >= 3:
         310	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_E_] = self.dof_list[2]
         311	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_X_] = Lx // (self.mg_grid[0] * self.mg_grid[0])
         312	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Y_] = Ly // (self.mg_grid[1] * self.mg_grid[1])
         313	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Z_] = Lz // (self.mg_grid[2] * self.mg_grid[2])
         314	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_T_] = Lt // (4 * self.mg_grid[3])
         315	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_MAX_ITER_] = 200
         316	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         317	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_NUM_RESTART_] = 3
         318	        av[define._MG_LEVEL1_ATOL_] = self.atol * self.coarse_tol_factor
         319	        if self.num_levels >= 3:
         320	            av[define._MG_LEVEL2_ATOL_] = self.atol * self.coarse_tol_factor
         321
         322	    def _worker(self, tid, shared):
         323	        """单线程完整 MG 流程（绑定 device_ids[tid % n]）。
         324
         325	        independent_problems=True 时每线程独立生成规范场/Clover/源与粗算子
         326	        （每线程不同 seed），无共享状态 —— 多卡吞吐并行模式；
         327	        否则共享输入 + 每线程拷贝（一致性验证模式）。
         328	        """
         329	        dev_id = self.device_ids[tid % len(self.device_ids)]
         330	        torch.cuda.set_device(dev_id)
         331	        dev = torch.device(f'cuda:{dev_id}')
         332	        params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t = _clone_state()
         333	        self._config_params(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, argv_t)
         334	        if self.independent_problems:
         335	            # 独立问题：规范场/Clover/源与粗算子由主线程在 V100 预构建
         336	            # （P100 无 torch kernel image，粗算子构建的 torch 运算只能在 V100
         337	            # 完成），本线程只做 D2D 拷贝 + C++ 求解。
         338	            st = shared['t'][tid]
         339	            g = st['g'].to(dev); fi = st['fi'].to(dev)
         340	            ce = st['ce'].to(dev); cei = st['cei'].to(dev)
         341	            coo = st['coo'].to(dev); coi = st['coi'].to(dev)
         342	            coarse = st['coarse']
         343	        else:
         344	            # 共享输入（规范场/Clover/源）拷贝到本卡
         345	            g = shared['g'].to(dev); fi = shared['fi'].to(dev)
         346	            ce = shared['ce'].to(dev); cei = shared['cei'].to(dev)
         347	            coo = shared['coo'].to(dev); coi = shared['coi'].to(dev)
         348	            coarse = shared['coarse']
         349	        # 2026-08-20 dev80 fix: 共享/独立模式均由主线程在 V100 预生成 gauge/clover 并拷贝，
         350	        # worker 不再本地重新生成（P100 sm_60 上 GaussGauge/BiStabCG 内核缺 image 且浪费显存）。
         351	        # 原逻辑共享模式每 worker 重跑 GaussGauge（seed 一致）+ 2 次 Clovers（各需 LatticeSet scratch），
         352	        # 在 32^4 上每 worker 额外 ~3GB scratch 且 P100 上直接 no kernel image。
         353	        # 现改为零拷贝复用：g/ce/coo 均为 V100 预生成后 D2D 拷贝到本卡，worker 仅需 BiStabCG/MG 的 plan1 LatticeSet。
         354	        # 若需独立 gauge 演化，改为主线程按 seed=42+tid 预生成（solve() 独立分支已做）。
         355	        pass  # gauge/clover 已由主线程生成并拷贝，无需 worker 本地重建
         356	        # 保留占位以保持 set_ptrs 槽位计数与旧逻辑兼容（但不再 init 0/1/2）
         357	        # 粗网格算子拷贝到本卡，填入 set_ptrs 槽位
         358	        # 注意：.to(dev) 在跨设备时产生新张量，必须保留引用（_coarse_dev），
         359	        # 否则临时对象被 GC 回收后 data_ptr 悬垂，C++ 求解读到垃圾（nan）。
         360	        _coarse_dev = []
         361	        for fl, (lonv, hnn, hdg, sit) in enumerate(coarse):
         362	            base = _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4 * fl
         363	            lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d = (lonv.to(dev).contiguous(),
         364	                                           hnn.to(dev).contiguous(),
         365	                                           hdg.to(dev).contiguous(),
         366	                                           sit.to(dev).contiguous())
         367	            _coarse_dev.extend([lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d])
         368	            set_ptrs_t[base + 0] = lonv_d.data_ptr()
         369	            set_ptrs_t[base + 1] = hnn_d.data_ptr()
         370	            set_ptrs_t[base + 2] = hdg_d.data_ptr()
         371	            set_ptrs_t[base + 3] = sit_d.data_ptr()
         372	        # 参考 BiStabCG（worker 仅需 plan1 的 2 个 LatticeSet，gauge/clover 已由主线程预生成并 D2D 拷贝）
         373	        params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         374	        params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
         375	        qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, argv_t)
         376	        fo_ref = torch.empty_like(fi)
         377	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); t0 = time.perf_counter()
         378	        qcu.applyCloverBistabCgQcu(fo_ref, fi, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         379	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); ref_time = time.perf_counter() - t0
         380	        # C++ Clover Multigrid
         381	        fo_mg = torch.empty_like(fi)
         382	        params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         383	        params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
         384	        qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, argv_t)
         385	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); t0 = time.perf_counter()
         386	        qcu.applyCloverMultigridQcu(fo_mg, fi, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         387	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); mg_time = time.perf_counter() - t0
         388	        # 释放本线程 LatticeSet（仅 0/BiStabCG 和 1/MG 两个槽位）
         389	        for _idx in (0, 1):
         390	            params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = _idx
         391	            try:
         392	                qcu.applyEndQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         393	            except Exception:
         394	                pass
         395	        return {'tid': tid, 'device': dev_id, 'mg': fo_mg.cpu(), 'ref': fo_ref.cpu(),
         396	                'ref_time': ref_time, 'mg_time': mg_time}
         397
         398	    def solve(self):
         399	        """并行求解：每线程一个完整 C++ MG 流程。返回 {'threads': [...], 'results': ...}。"""
         400	        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
         401	        # 主线程 Python 层运算（粗算子构建、poooxyzt2oooxyzt、make_clover 等）
         402	        # 统一在 cuda:0（V100, sm_70+）：P100(sm_60) 无 torch kernel image，
         403	        # 任何 torch 内核在 P100 上都会报 cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice；
         404	        # workers 各卡只做 D2D 拷贝 + C++ 求解（libqcu.so 含 sm_60 SASS）。
         405	        main_dev = torch.device('cuda:0')
         406	        # BUGFIX 2026-08-15: 主线程 current device 必须锁定 V100。上一实例
         407	        # （或本实例共享模式结尾）可能把主线程 current device 切到 P100
         408	        # （torch.cuda.set_device 是进程级、C++ 线程局部 current device 跟随），
         409	        # 导致后续实例主线程的 C++ 调用（applyInitQcu/applyGaussGaugeQcu 等）
         410	        # 在 P100 上执行而张量在 V100 → illegal memory access。
         411	        # （CUDA current device 是线程局部的：主线程显式设定 V100 后，
         412	        #   worker 线程各自 set_device 不受影响。）
         413	        torch.cuda.set_device(int(main_dev.index))
         414	        # 主线程预热 torch lazy 初始化（clover inverse 等）：worker 线程并发
         415	        # 首次触发 torch.linalg.inv 等 lazy backend 会报 "lazy wrapper should
         416	        # be called at most once"，预热后在主线程完成初始化。
         417	        try:
         418	            _w = torch.randn([4, 4], dtype=self.dt, device=main_dev)
         419	            torch.linalg.inv(_w)
         420	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
         421	        except Exception:
         422	            pass

         148	    def _coarse_dslash_cuda(self, src: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor:
         149	        """CUDA-accelerated coarse-grid dslash using C++ backend.
         150
         151	        Applies the coarse-grid Dirac operator D_coarse = sitting + hopping_plus + hopping_minus.
         152	        Data layout:
         153	          - fermion:  [E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         154	          - hopping:  [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc] (pm × dir × Eout × Ein × XYZT)
         155	          - sitting:  [E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         156	        """
         157	        op = self.op_list[level]
         158	        E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = src.shape
         159	        # NOTE: SET_INDEX_ is reset to 0 for coarse dslash. This is safe because
         160	        # the coarse dslash operates at a different multigrid level and does not
         161	        # overlap with fine-level BiCGStab iterations that increment SET_INDEX_.
         162	        # If coarse dslash were ever called concurrently with fine-level ops,
         163	        # a dedicated SET_INDEX_ per level would be required.
         164	        self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         165	        # Pack hopping matrices: [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         166	        # dim0: 0=plus, 1=minus; dim1: 0=X, 1=Y, 2=Z, 3=T
         167	        target_shape = torch.Size([2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc])
         168	        if (self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed is None or
         169	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.shape != target_shape or
         170	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.device != src.device or
         171	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level != level):
         172	            hopping_packed = torch.zeros(
         173	                target_shape, dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         174	            for ward in range(4):
         175	                hopping_packed[0, ward] = op.hopping.M_plus_list[ward].to(
         176	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         177	                hopping_packed[1, ward] = op.hopping.M_minus_list[ward].to(
         178	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         179	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed = hopping_packed
         180	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level = level
         181	        # Set multigrid params for the C++ backend
         182	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Xc
         183	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Yc
         184	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Zc
         185	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Tc
         186	        self.params[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = E  # coarse DOF (repurposed)
         187	        # Ensure sitting tensor is on the correct device and dtype
         188	        sitting = op.sitting.M.to(dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         189	        # Allocate or reuse output tensor
         190	        if (self._mg_coarse_dslash_out is None or
         191	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.shape != src.shape or
         192	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.device != src.device):
         193	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out = torch.zeros_like(src)
         194	        qcu.applyMultigridCoarseDslashQcu(
         195	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out, src,
         196	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed, sitting,
         197	            self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         198	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         199	        return self._mg_coarse_dslash_out
         200
         201	    def _verify_coarse_dslash(self, level: int = 1, tol: float = 1e-3) -> bool:
         202	        """Debug helper: verify CUDA coarse dslash against Python einsum version.
         203
         204	        Generates random input, compares CUDA output with Python reference.
         205	        Returns True if max absolute difference < tol.
         206	        """
         207	        op = self.op_list[level]
         208	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = self.lat_size_list[level]
         209	        E = self.dof_list[level]
         210	        dtype = self.dtype_list[level]
         211	        device = self.device_list[level]
         212	        src = torch.randn([E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc], dtype=dtype, device=device)
         213	        # Python reference (einsum-based)
         214	        ref = op.matvec(src)
         215	        # CUDA path
         216	        cu = self._coarse_dslash_cuda(src, level=level)
         217	        diff = (ref - cu).abs().max().item()
         218	        if self.rank == self.root:
         219	            print(f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::VERIFY:\n "
         220	                  f"level={level}, max|ref-cuda| = {diff:.6e}")
         221	        return diff < tol

         223	    def init(self):

         237	                define._GRID_T_] = tools.give_grid_size()

         240	            params[define._NODE_SIZE_] = self.comm.Get_size()

         248	            params[define._SEED_] = 42
         249	            argv = argv.to(dtype=define.dtype(
         250	                params[define._DATA_TYPE_]).to_real())
         251	            argv[define._MASS_] = self.mass
         252	            argv[define._ATOL_] = self.tol

         338	    def adaptive(self, iter: int = 0):
         339	        if self.convergence_tol > 3:
         340	            self.num_level = 1
         341	        if (iter+1)*2 < self.num_convergence_sample+1:
         342	            return

         344	        convergence_sample = self.convergence_history[-(
         345	            self.num_convergence_sample+1):-1]
         346	        count = 0
         347	        for convergence in convergence_sample:
         348	            if convergence < convergence_now:
         349	                count += 1
         350	        if count >= self.num_convergence_sample//2:
         351	            self.convergence_tol += 1

         353	    def cycle(self, level: int = 0) -> torch.Tensor:

         171	def _setup_gpu_tensors(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, device, mass, atol, dt, seed=42,
         172	                       verbose=False):
         173	    """在指定设备上生成规范场/Clover 项/源（C++ 后端）。
         174
         175	    返回 (g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa)。
         176	    """
         177	    params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         178	    params_t[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0
         179	    params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         180	    params_t[define._DAGGER_] = 0
         181	    params_t[define._MAX_ITER_] = 1000
         182	    params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 1 if verbose else 0
         183	    params_t[define._SEED_] = seed
         184	    params_t[define._TEST_IN_CPU_] = 0
         185	    av = argv_t.to(dtype=define.dtype(define.epytd(dt)).to_real())
         186	    av[define._MASS_] = mass
         187	    av[define._ATOL_] = atol
         188	    av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         189	    ls = define.lat_shape(params_t)
         190	    # P100(sm_60) 兼容：torch 2.10 无 sm_60 kernel image，zeros/randn 填充内核
         191	    # 在 P100 上失败并污染 CUDA 错误状态；empty（纯 cudaMalloc）与 CPU 生成 +
         192	    # H2D 拷贝（driver memcpy）均可用。C++ 后端会写满 g/ce/coo 等输出缓冲。
         193	    g = torch.empty([2, 3, 3, 4] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         194	    fi = torch.randn([2, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device='cpu').to(device)
         195	    ce = torch.empty([4, 3, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         196	    cei = torch.empty_like(ce); coo = torch.empty_like(ce); coi = torch.empty_like(ce)
         197	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = -1
         198	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyGaussGaugeQcu(g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         199	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         200	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(ce, cei, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         201	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 1
         202	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(coo, coi, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         203	    U_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g)
         204	    b_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(fi)
         205	    kappa = 1.0 / (2 * mass + 8)
         206	    clover_full = dslash.make_clover(U_full, kappa=kappa)
         207	    return g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa, av

         210	class MultiGpuMultigrid(object):
         211	    """多线程多卡 C++ Clover Multigrid 驱动（一线程一卡）。
         212
         213	    构造参数：
         214	        lat_size: [Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt]
         215	        mass / atol: 求解质量参数与容差
         216	        num_levels / dof_list / mg_grid / num_restart / coarse_max_iter /
         217	        coarse_tol_factor / nv_iters: 粗网格配置（同 conftest.schur.multigrid）
         218	        nthreads: 线程数（默认 = 设备数）
         219	        device_ids: 显式设备 id 列表（默认 range(可见设备数)；
         220	            线程 tid 绑定 device_ids[tid % len(device_ids)]）
         221	        use_cache / cache_dir: 粗网格算子 h5py 缓存
         222	        verbose: 详细输出
         223
         224	    方法：
         225	        solve(): 并行求解（每线程一个完整 MG 流程），返回结果字典
         226	        verify_consistency(tol): 线程间解与主线程参考解的一致性校验
         227	    """
         228
         229	    def __init__(self, lat_size=None, mass=0.05, atol=1e-6, num_levels=2,
         230	                 dof_list=None, mg_grid=None, num_restart=5, coarse_max_iter=15,
         231	                 coarse_tol_factor=1e5, nv_iters=2, nthreads=None, device_ids=None,
         232	                 use_cache=True, cache_dir=None, verbose=True,
         233	                 independent_problems=False):
         234	        from mpi4py import MPI
         235	        # C++ LatticeSet::init 用 MPI_COMM_WORLD 真实 rank 覆盖 _NODE_RANK_，
         236	        # 多线程独立实例语义要求单 rank（多进程分布走每进程单线程实例路径）。
         237	        if MPI.COMM_WORLD.Get_size() > 1:
         238	            raise RuntimeError(
         239	                "PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n MultiGpuMultigrid requires a single "
         240	                "MPI rank (mpirun -np 1): multi-process distribution uses "
         241	                "per-rank single-thread instances; multi-GPU parallelism inside "
         242	                "one process uses one-thread-one-GPU.")
         243	        if lat_size is None:
         244	            lat_size = [8, 8, 8, 16]
         245	        if mg_grid is None:
         246	            mg_grid = [2, 2, 2, 2]
         247	        self.lat_size = list(lat_size)
         248	        self.mass = mass
         249	        self.atol = atol
         250	        self.num_levels = num_levels
         251	        if dof_list is None:
         252	            dof_list = [12, 48, 48, 48, 48]
         253	        self.dof_list = dof_list[:num_levels]
         254	        self.mg_grid = mg_grid
         255	        self.num_restart = num_restart
         256	        self.coarse_max_iter = coarse_max_iter
         257	        self.coarse_tol_factor = coarse_tol_factor
         258	        self.nv_iters = nv_iters
         259	        self.verbose = verbose
         260	        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
         261	        self.use_cache = use_cache
         262	        num_gpus = torch.cuda.device_count() if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0
         263	        if num_gpus == 0:
         264	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n no CUDA device available")
         265	        if device_ids is None:
         266	            device_ids = list(range(num_gpus))
         267	        self.device_ids = [int(d) for d in device_ids]
         268	        if nthreads is None:
         269	            nthreads = len(self.device_ids)
         270	        self.nthreads = nthreads
         271	        self.dt = torch.complex64
         272	        self.independent_problems = independent_problems
         273	        self._results = None
         274
         275	    def _build_coarse_ops(self, S, E, device):
         276	        """主线程构建 Schur 粗网格算子（h5py 缓存）。"""
         277	        return build_schur_levels(
         278	            op=None, S=S, num_levels=self.num_levels, dof_list=self.dof_list,
         279	            mg_grid=self.mg_grid, lat_full=self.lat_size, E=E, dt=self.dt,
         280	            device=device, nv_iters=self.nv_iters, use_cache=self.use_cache,
         281	            cache_dir=self.cache_dir, verbose=self.verbose)
         282
         283	    def _config_params(self, params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, av):
         284	        Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt = self.lat_size
         285	        params_t[define._LAT_X_] = Lx; params_t[define._LAT_Y_] = Ly
         286	        params_t[define._LAT_Z_] = Lz; params_t[define._LAT_T_] = Lt
         287	        params_t[define._LAT_XYZT_] = Lx * Ly * Lz * Lt
         288	        # 每线程/每进程独立完整实例：单 rank 网格（无 MPI 分布 halo），
         289	        # 多卡并行通过线程×卡绑定实现，不依赖 MPI 通信。
         290	        params_t[define._GRID_X_], params_t[define._GRID_Y_], \
         291	            params_t[define._GRID_Z_], params_t[define._GRID_T_] = 1, 1, 1, 1
         292	        params_t[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0
         293	        params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         294	        params_t[define._DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         295	        # mass/atol/sigma 必须显式设置（模块级 argv 默认 mass=-3.5 会奇异）
         296	        av[define._MASS_] = self.mass
         297	        av[define._ATOL_] = self.atol
         298	        av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         299	        params_t[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = self.num_levels
         300	        if self.num_levels >= 2:
         301	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_E_] = self.dof_list[1]
         302	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Lx // self.mg_grid[0]
         303	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Ly // self.mg_grid[1]
         304	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Lz // self.mg_grid[2]
         305	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Lt // (2 * self.mg_grid[3])
         306	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_MAX_ITER_] = self.coarse_max_iter
         307	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         308	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_NUM_RESTART_] = self.num_restart
         309	        if self.num_levels >= 3:
         310	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_E_] = self.dof_list[2]
         311	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_X_] = Lx // (self.mg_grid[0] * self.mg_grid[0])
         312	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Y_] = Ly // (self.mg_grid[1] * self.mg_grid[1])
         313	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Z_] = Lz // (self.mg_grid[2] * self.mg_grid[2])
         314	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_T_] = Lt // (4 * self.mg_grid[3])
         315	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_MAX_ITER_] = 200
         316	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         317	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_NUM_RESTART_] = 3

         319	        if self.num_levels >= 3:

         396	                'ref_time': ref_time, 'mg_time': mg_time}

         547	    def save_report(self, path: str):
         548	        """导出求解报告（JSON：配置/每线程耗时/残差/一致性）。"""
         549	        import json
         550	        if self._results is None:
         551	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         552	        rep = dict(self._results)
         553	        rep['threads'] = [{k: (float(v) if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.numel() == 1
         554	                               else (v.tolist() if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.numel() <= 16
         555	                                     else (f"<tensor{v.shape}>" if torch.is_tensor(v) else v)))
         556	                           for k, v in t.items()} for t in rep['threads']]
         557	        rep['device_ids'] = list(rep['device_ids'])
         558	        rep['dof_list'] = list(rep['dof_list'])
         559	        rep['lat_size'] = list(rep['lat_size'])
         560	        with open(path, 'w') as f:
         561	            json.dump(rep, f, indent=2)
         562	        print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n report saved to {path}")

         564	    def verify_consistency(self, tol: float = 1e-5) -> dict:
         565	        """校验各线程解与线程 0 解（参考）的一致性（相对误差 < tol）。"""
         566	        if self._results is None:
         567	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         568	        threads = self._results['threads']
         569	        ref = threads[0]['mg']
         570	        checks = []
         571	        for t in threads:
         572	            rel = float((t['mg'] - ref).abs().max() / (ref.abs().max() + 1e-30))
         573	            checks.append({'tid': t['tid'], 'device': t['device'],
         574	                           'rel_max_diff': rel, 'pass': rel < tol})
         575	        all_pass = all(c['pass'] for c in checks)
         576	        summary = {'tol': tol, 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all_pass}
         577	        if self.verbose:
         578	            print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n consistency verify (tol={tol}): "
         579	                  f"{'PASS' if all_pass else 'FAIL'}")
         580	            for c in checks:
         581	                print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n   tid={c['tid']} device={c['device']} "
         582	                      f"rel_max_diff={c['rel_max_diff']:.3e}")
         583	        return summary
         584

         586	def verify_multi_gpu_mg(**kwargs):
         587	    """一行式验证入口（供 pyqcu.testing / examples 使用）。
         588
         589	    kwargs 透传 MultiGpuMultigrid（lat_size/mass/atol/nthreads/...）。
         590	    返回 (results, consistency)。
         591	    """
         592	    mg = MultiGpuMultigrid(**kwargs)
         593	    results = mg.solve()
         594	    consistency = mg.verify_consistency(tol=kwargs.get('tol', 1e-5))
         595	    return results, consistency

           5	def bench(lat, mass=0.05, atol=1e-6, num_levels=2, nthreads=3,

          14	    t0 = time.perf_counter()

          20	    return {

          27	        'multi_ref_wall': round(ref_max, 4),
          28	        'multi_mg_wall': round(mg_max, 4),

          40	def t_clover_solve_and_truth():
          41	    """G4.1 基线：全求解器解的全算子真相对残差（修复后应 ~1e-7）。"""
          42	    lat, m = LAT_DEFAULT, MASS_DEFAULT
          43	    kappa = 1.0 / (2 * m + 8)
          44	    g = load_gauge_h5(lat, m, device="cuda")
          45	    ce, cei, coo, coi, s, p, av = make_clover_tensors(g, lat, m)
          46	    gen = torch.Generator("cpu").manual_seed(43)
          47	    b_eo = torch.randn([2, 4, 3] + define.lat_shape(p), generator=gen,
          48	                       dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu").to(torch.complex64).to("cuda")
          49	    x = torch.zeros_like(b_eo)
          50	    p[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1; p[define._PARITY_] = 0
          51	    p[define._MAX_ITER_] = 1000; p[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
          52	    idx = int(p[define._SET_INDEX_].item()); av[define._ATOL_] = 1e-6
          53	    qcu.applyInitQcu(s, p, av)
          54	    torch.cuda.synchronize(); t0 = time.perf_counter()
          55	    qcu.applyCloverBistabCgQcu(x, b_eo, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, s, p)
          56	    torch.cuda.synchronize(); wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
          57	    p[define._SET_INDEX_] = idx; qcu.applyEndQcu(s, p)
          58	    U = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g); cl = dslash.make_clover(U, kappa=kappa)
          59	    xf = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(x); bf = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(b_eo)
          60	    r = dslash.give_wilson(xf, U, kappa, True) + dslash.give_clover(xf, cl) - bf
          61	    rel = float(tools.norm(r) / tools.norm(bf))
          62	    check("clover_solve_true_res", rel < 1e-5,
          63	          f"rel={rel:.3e} wall={wall:.2f}s (bug42 修复口径)")

         253	def cmd_setup_staged(args):
         254	    """dev84 指令23 三阶段分进程构建（大体量 OOM 规避）：
         255	      stage=nulls   : CudaSchurOp 逆迭代 -> data/<tag>.rawnulls.h5   后退出
         256	      stage=ortho   : CPU local_orthogonalize -> data/<tag>.lonv.h5  后退出
         257	      stage=stencil : 全新进程建算子+流式探测 -> data/<tag> 完整缓存     后退出
         258	    每进程只持一份大资产。"""

         384	            pass
         385	    prof = {}
         386	    if found["PROF_SECTIONS"]:
         387	        for kv in re.findall(r'(\w+)=([0-9.]+)', found["PROF_SECTIONS"]):
         388	            try:

         398	def solve_mg(g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, clover_full, lat, mass, atol,
         399	             num_levels, E, device_gen, timeout=300, verbose=False,
         400	             rs=5, cf=3e3, cmi=200, nvi=20, mp=False, gcr=False, deflate=False,
         401	             nvsuf=""):
         402	    """applyCloverMultigridQcu (num_levels 层)。setup 走 data/ 缓存, 只计 solve 墙钟。
         403	    gcr=True 时 params[_MG_USE_GCR_]=1 → C++ run_gcr (FGMRES(10)⊕V-cycle 预条件子, quda 式)。
         404	    返回 (fo, t_solve, conv, prof, stat, err)。"""
         405	    def _run():
         406	        nonlocal U_full, clover_full
         407	        p = mod_params.clone(); a = mod_argv.clone(); s = mod_set_ptrs.clone()
         408	        Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt = lat
         409	        p[define._LAT_X_] = Lx; p[define._LAT_Y_] = Ly; p[define._LAT_Z_] = Lz; p[define._LAT_T_] = Lt
         410	        p[define._LAT_XYZT_] = Lx * Ly * Lz * Lt
         411	        p[define._GRID_X_], p[define._GRID_Y_], p[define._GRID_Z_], p[define._GRID_T_] = 1, 1, 1, 1
         412	        p[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0; p[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         413	        p[define._DATA_TYPE_] = DT
         414	        av = a.to(dtype=define.dtype(DT).to_real())
         415	        av[define._MASS_] = mass; av[define._ATOL_] = atol; av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         416	        p[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = num_levels
         417	        p[define._MG_USE_GCR_] = 1 if gcr else 0
         418	        p[define._MG_USE_DEFLATE_] = 1 if deflate else 0
         419	        p[define._MG_MU_PRE_] = 4
         420	        if num_levels >= 2:
         421	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_E_] = E
         422	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Lx // MG_GRID[0]
         423	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Ly // MG_GRID[1]
         424	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Lz // MG_GRID[2]
         425	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Lt // (2 * MG_GRID[3])
         426	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_MAX_ITER_] = cmi
         427	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_DATA_TYPE_] = DT_C32 if mp else DT
         428	            p[define._MG_LEVEL1_NUM_RESTART_] = rs
         429	            av[define._MG_LEVEL1_ATOL_] = atol * cf
         430	        # --- setup: nullvec/stencil 缓存命中或构建 (不计入 solve 时间) ---
         431	        if num_levels >= 2:
         432	            lonv, hnn, hdg, sit = load_nullvec(lat, E, nvi, torch.device("cuda:0"), suf=nvsuf)
         433	            del U_full, clover_full
         434	            import gc
         435	            gc.collect(); torch.cuda.empty_cache()
         436	            s[30 + 0] = lonv.contiguous().data_ptr()
         437	            s[30 + 1] = hnn.contiguous().data_ptr()
         438	            s[30 + 2] = hdg.contiguous().data_ptr()
         439	            s[30 + 3] = sit.contiguous().data_ptr()
         440	        # --- solve (计时段) ---
         441	        p[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; p[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         442	        p[define._VERBOSE_] = 1 if verbose else 0
         443	        qcu.applyInitQcu(s, p, av)
         444	        fo = torch.empty_like(fi)
         445	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         446	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
         447	        qcu.applyCloverMultigridQcu(fo, fi, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, s, p)
         448	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         449	        t = time.perf_counter() - t0
         450	        parsed = parse_last_log()
         451	        p[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         452	        qcu.applyEndQcu(s, p)
         453	        return fo, t, parsed["conv"], parsed["prof"]
         454	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as ex:
         455	        fut = ex.submit(_run)
         456	        try:
         457	            fo, t, conv, prof = fut.result(timeout=timeout)
         458	            return fo, t, conv, prof, "OK", None
         459	        except TimeoutError:
         460	            return None, float(timeout), [], {}, "TIMEOUT", "MG %dL timeout >%ds" % (num_levels, timeout)
         461	        except Exception:
         462	            return None, 0.0, [], {}, "FAIL", traceback.format_exc()
         463

         465	def full_residual_rel(x_full_dev, g, fi, kappa):
         466	    """Python 全算子相对残差 ||D x - b||/||b|| (奇偶掩码布局)。"""
         467	    U = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g)
         468	    src = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(fi)
         469	    out = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(x_full_dev)
         470	    cl = dslash.make_clover(U, kappa=kappa)
         471	    r = tools.norm(dslash.give_wilson(out, U, kappa, True) + dslash.give_clover(out, cl) - src)
         472	    return float(r / tools.norm(src))
         473

         597	        ok &= res_ok and rel_ok

         602	def cmd_multi(args):
         603	    lat = [int(x) for x in args.lat.split(",")]
         604	    # 兼容两种输入: "1,2"(层列表,len=层数) / 单整数 "N"(=N 层); 默认值 "1,2" 此前 int() 直接崩溃

         608	    common = dict(lat_size=lat, mass=args.mass, atol=args.atol, num_levels=nl,
         609	                  dof_list=dof, mg_grid=MG_GRID, num_restart=args.rs,
         610	                  coarse_max_iter=args.cmi, coarse_tol_factor=args.cf,
         611	                  nv_iters=args.nvi, use_cache=True, cache_dir=str(DATA_DIR), verbose=False)
         612	    print(f"=== dev84 multi: single V100 vs P100x2 ({lat}, {nl}L, dof={dof}) ===")
         613	    mg_s = MultiGpuMultigrid(nthreads=1, device_ids=[0], **common)
         614	    rs_ = mg_s.solve()
         615	    t_single = max(t['mg_time'] for t in rs_['threads'])
         616	    t_single_ref = max(t['ref_time'] for t in rs_['threads'])
         617	    cons_s = mg_s.verify_consistency(tol=1e-5)
         618	    print(f"single V100 : mg_wall={t_single:.3f}s bistabcg_wall={t_single_ref:.3f}s "
         619	          f"consistency={'PASS' if cons_s['all_pass'] else 'FAIL'}")
         620	    row = {"single_v100_mg": t_single, "single_v100_bistabcg": t_single_ref,
         621	           "single_consistency": cons_s}
         622	    try:
         623	        mg_m = MultiGpuMultigrid(nthreads=2, device_ids=[1, 2], **common)
         624	        rm = mg_m.solve()
         625	        t_multi = max(t['mg_time'] for t in rm['threads'])
         626	        t_multi_ref = max(t['ref_time'] for t in rm['threads'])
         627	        cons_m = mg_m.verify_consistency(tol=1e-5)
         628	        par = t_single / t_multi
         629	        print(f"multi P100x2: mg_wall={t_multi:.3f}s bistabcg_wall={t_multi_ref:.3f}s "
         630	              f"consistency={'PASS' if cons_m['all_pass'] else 'FAIL'}")
         631	        print(f"parallel speedup (single/multi) = {par:.3f}x")
         632	        row.update({"multi_p100x2_mg": t_multi, "multi_p100x2_bistabcg": t_multi_ref,
         633	                    "multi_consistency": cons_m, "parallel_speedup_mg": par})
         634	    except Exception as e:
         635	        traceback.print_exc()
         636	        row.update({"multi_error": str(e)})
         637	    with open(OUT_DIR / "multi_report.json", "w") as f:
         638	        json.dump(row, f, indent=2, default=str)

          25	        self.mass = (1/self.kappa - 8)/2  # just for plot......

          27	        self.tol = tol
          28	        self.max_iter = max_iter
          29	        self.num_restart = num_restart
          30	        self.root = root
          31	        self.with_cuda_qcu = True if self.clover_ee_inv is not None and self.clover_oo_inv is not None else False
          32	        self.support_parity = support_parity
          33	        self.verbose = verbose
          34	        # Build grid list
          35	        self.lat_size_list = []
          36	        self.mg_grid_size = mg_grid_size
          37	        _lat_size = self.lat_size
          38	        while all(_ >= self.min_size for _ in _lat_size) and len(self.lat_size_list) < self.max_level:
          39	            self.lat_size_list.append(_lat_size)
          40	            _lat_size = [_lat_size[d] // self.mg_grid_size[d]
          41	                         for d in range(4)]
          42	        self.num_level = len(self.lat_size_list)
          43	        self.dof_list = dof_list[:self.num_level]
          44	        self.dtype_list = dtype_list[:self.num_level]
          45	        self.device_list = device_list[:self.num_level]
          46	        if self.rank == self.root:
          47	            print(
          48	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n self.dof_list:{self.dof_list}")
          49	            print(
          50	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n self.dtype_list:{self.dtype_list}")
          51	            print(
          52	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n self.device_list:{self.device_list}")
          53	            print(
          54	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n self.lat_size_list:{self.lat_size_list}")
          55	        for device in self.device_list:
          56	            tools.set_device(device=device)
          57	        self.op_list = [dslash.operator(U=U,
          58	                                        clover_term=clover_term, verbose=self.verbose, kappa=self.kappa, u_0=self.u_0, support_parity=self.support_parity, clover_ee_inv=self.clover_ee_inv, clover_oo_inv=self.clover_oo_inv,)]
          59	        if seed is not None:
          60	            # bug40 后续: 多线程实例并行时全局 RNG 竞争使初始 b/x0 非确定;
          61	            # 显式 seed 时用本地 Generator(每实例独立流),残差可复现。
          62	            # 实数 randn 无需 cann 复数分解; cann.randn 不透传 generator 故直用 torch
          63	            g_b = torch.Generator(device=self.device_list[0]).manual_seed(seed)
          64	            self.b = torch.randn(size=[12]+self.lat_size,
          65	                                 dtype=self.dtype_list[0],
          66	                                 device=self.device_list[0],
          67	                                 generator=g_b)
          68	            g_x = torch.Generator(device=self.device_list[0]).manual_seed(seed + 1_000_000)
          69	            self.x0 = torch.randn(
          70	                size=[12]+self.lat_size, dtype=self.dtype_list[0],
          71	                device=self.device_list[0], generator=g_x)
          72	        else:
          73	            self.b = _torch.randn(size=[12]+self.lat_size,
          74	                                  dtype=self.dtype_list[0], device=self.device_list[0])
          75	            self.x0 = _torch.randn(
          76	                size=[12]+self.lat_size, dtype=self.dtype_list[0], device=self.device_list[0])
          77	        self.b_list = [self.b.clone()]
          78	        self.nv_list = []  # null_vecs_list
          79	        self.lonv_list = []  # local_ortho_null_vecs_list
          80	        self.num_convergence_sample = num_convergence_sample
          81	        self.convergence_history = []
          82	        self.convergence_tol = 0
          83	        # Pre-allocated CUDA tensors for restrict/prolong (level 0 -> 1)
          84	        self._mg_restrict_out = None
          85	        self._mg_prolong_out = None
          86	        self._mg_coarse_dslash_out = None
          87	        self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed = None
          88	        self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level = None  # track which level is cached
          89	        self._max_set_index = -1  # init 创建的 C++ LatticeSet 最大槽位（end 释放用）
          90
          91	    def _restrict_cuda(self, fine_vec: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor:
          92	        """CUDA-accelerated restriction using C++ backend."""
          93	        lonv = self.lonv_list[level]
          94	        E = lonv.shape[0]
          95	        e = fine_vec.shape[0]
          96	        Xf, Yf, Zf, Tf = fine_vec.shape[1:]
          97	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = self.lat_size_list[level+1]
          98	        # Set multigrid params
          99	        self.params[define._LAT_X_] = Xf
         100	        self.params[define._LAT_Y_] = Yf
         101	        self.params[define._LAT_Z_] = Zf
         102	        self.params[define._LAT_T_] = Tf
         103	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Xc
         104	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Yc
         105	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Zc
         106	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Tc
         107	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_E_] = E
         108	        self.params[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = e  # fine DOF
         109	        # Allocate or reuse output tensor
         110	        if self._mg_restrict_out is None or self._mg_restrict_out.shape != torch.Size([E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]):
         111	            self._mg_restrict_out = torch.zeros(
         112	                [E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc], dtype=fine_vec.dtype, device=fine_vec.device)
         113	        qcu.applyMultigridRestrictQcu(
         114	            self._mg_restrict_out, fine_vec, lonv, self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         115	        torch.cuda.synchronize()  # C++ 私有流完成后再返回（固定缓冲复用）
         116	        return self._mg_restrict_out
         117
         118	    def _prolong_cuda(self, coarse_vec: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor:
         119	        """CUDA-accelerated prolongation using C++ backend."""
         120	        lonv = self.lonv_list[level]
         121	        E = coarse_vec.shape[0]
         122	        e = lonv.shape[1]
         123	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = coarse_vec.shape[1:]
         124	        Xf = Xc * self.mg_grid_size[0]
         125	        Yf = Yc * self.mg_grid_size[1]
         126	        Zf = Zc * self.mg_grid_size[2]
         127	        Tf = Tc * self.mg_grid_size[3]
         128	        # Set multigrid params
         129	        self.params[define._LAT_X_] = Xf
         130	        self.params[define._LAT_Y_] = Yf
         131	        self.params[define._LAT_Z_] = Zf
         132	        self.params[define._LAT_T_] = Tf
         133	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Xc
         134	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Yc
         135	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Zc
         136	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Tc
         137	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_E_] = E
         138	        self.params[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = e  # fine DOF
         139	        # Allocate or reuse output tensor
         140	        if self._mg_prolong_out is None or self._mg_prolong_out.shape != torch.Size([e, Xf, Yf, Zf, Tf]):
         141	            self._mg_prolong_out = torch.zeros(
         142	                [e, Xf, Yf, Zf, Tf], dtype=coarse_vec.dtype, device=coarse_vec.device)
         143	        qcu.applyMultigridProLongQcu(
         144	            self._mg_prolong_out, coarse_vec, lonv, self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         145	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         146	        return self._mg_prolong_out
         147
         148	    def _coarse_dslash_cuda(self, src: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor:
         149	        """CUDA-accelerated coarse-grid dslash using C++ backend.
         150
         151	        Applies the coarse-grid Dirac operator D_coarse = sitting + hopping_plus + hopping_minus.
         152	        Data layout:
         153	          - fermion:  [E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         154	          - hopping:  [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc] (pm × dir × Eout × Ein × XYZT)
         155	          - sitting:  [E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         156	        """
         157	        op = self.op_list[level]
         158	        E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = src.shape
         159	        # NOTE: SET_INDEX_ is reset to 0 for coarse dslash. This is safe because
         160	        # the coarse dslash operates at a different multigrid level and does not
         161	        # overlap with fine-level BiCGStab iterations that increment SET_INDEX_.
         162	        # If coarse dslash were ever called concurrently with fine-level ops,
         163	        # a dedicated SET_INDEX_ per level would be required.
         164	        self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         165	        # Pack hopping matrices: [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         166	        # dim0: 0=plus, 1=minus; dim1: 0=X, 1=Y, 2=Z, 3=T
         167	        target_shape = torch.Size([2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc])
         168	        if (self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed is None or
         169	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.shape != target_shape or
         170	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.device != src.device or
         171	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level != level):
         172	            hopping_packed = torch.zeros(
         173	                target_shape, dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         174	            for ward in range(4):
         175	                hopping_packed[0, ward] = op.hopping.M_plus_list[ward].to(
         176	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         177	                hopping_packed[1, ward] = op.hopping.M_minus_list[ward].to(
         178	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         179	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed = hopping_packed
         180	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level = level
         181	        # Set multigrid params for the C++ backend
         182	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Xc
         183	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Yc
         184	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Zc
         185	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Tc
         186	        self.params[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = E  # coarse DOF (repurposed)
         187	        # Ensure sitting tensor is on the correct device and dtype
         188	        sitting = op.sitting.M.to(dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         189	        # Allocate or reuse output tensor
         190	        if (self._mg_coarse_dslash_out is None or
         191	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.shape != src.shape or
         192	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.device != src.device):
         193	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out = torch.zeros_like(src)
         194	        qcu.applyMultigridCoarseDslashQcu(
         195	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out, src,
         196	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed, sitting,
         197	            self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         198	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         199	        return self._mg_coarse_dslash_out
         200
         201	    def _verify_coarse_dslash(self, level: int = 1, tol: float = 1e-3) -> bool:
         202	        """Debug helper: verify CUDA coarse dslash against Python einsum version.
         203
         204	        Generates random input, compares CUDA output with Python reference.
         205	        Returns True if max absolute difference < tol.
         206	        """
         207	        op = self.op_list[level]
         208	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = self.lat_size_list[level]
         209	        E = self.dof_list[level]
         210	        dtype = self.dtype_list[level]
         211	        device = self.device_list[level]
         212	        src = torch.randn([E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc], dtype=dtype, device=device)
         213	        # Python reference (einsum-based)
         214	        ref = op.matvec(src)
         215	        # CUDA path
         216	        cu = self._coarse_dslash_cuda(src, level=level)
         217	        diff = (ref - cu).abs().max().item()
         218	        if self.rank == self.root:
         219	            print(f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::VERIFY:\n "
         220	                  f"level={level}, max|ref-cuda| = {diff:.6e}")
         221	        return diff < tol
         222
         223	    def init(self):
         224	        # Build local-orthonormal near-null space vectors
         225	        comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
         226	        comm.Barrier()
         227	        if self.with_cuda_qcu:
         228	            from pyqcu.cuda.define import params, argv, set_ptrs
         229	            params[define._LAT_X_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_X_]
         230	            params[define._LAT_Y_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_Y_]
         231	            params[define._LAT_Z_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_Z_]
         232	            params[define._LAT_T_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_T_]
         233	            params[define._LAT_XYZT_] = params[define._LAT_X_] * \
         234	                params[define._LAT_Y_]*params[define._LAT_Z_] * \
         235	                params[define._LAT_T_]
         236	            params[define._GRID_X_], params[define._GRID_Y_], params[define._GRID_Z_], params[
         237	                define._GRID_T_] = tools.give_grid_size()
         238	            params[define._PARITY_] = 0
         239	            params[define._NODE_RANK_] = self.comm.Get_rank()
         240	            params[define._NODE_SIZE_] = self.comm.Get_size()
         241	            params[define._DAGGER_] = 0
         242	            params[define._MAX_ITER_] = self.max_iter
         243	            params[define._DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(
         244	                torch_dtype=self.dtype_list[0])
         245	            params[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         246	            params[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         247	            params[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
         248	            params[define._SEED_] = 42
         249	            argv = argv.to(dtype=define.dtype(
         250	                params[define._DATA_TYPE_]).to_real())
         251	            argv[define._MASS_] = self.mass
         252	            argv[define._ATOL_] = self.tol
         253	            argv[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         254	            self.set_ptrs = set_ptrs.clone()
         255	            self.params = params.clone()
         256	            self.argv = argv.clone()
         257	            qcu.applyInitQcu(self.set_ptrs, self.params, self.argv)
         258	            self._max_set_index = max(
         259	                self._max_set_index, int(self.params[define._SET_INDEX_]))
         260	            self.gauge_eo = tools.oooxyzt2poooxyzt(
         261	                input_array=self.op_list[0].hopping.U)  # type: ignore
         262	            self.clover_ee = self.op_list[0].sitting.M_e
         263	            self.clover_oo = self.op_list[0].sitting.M_o
         264	            self.fermion_in_eo = torch.zeros(size=[2, 4, 3]+define.lat_shape(params)).to(
         265	                dtype=define.dtype(params[define._DATA_TYPE_]), device=torch.device('cuda'))
         266	            self.fermion_out_eo = torch.zeros(size=[2, 4, 3]+define.lat_shape(params)).to(
         267	                dtype=define.dtype(params[define._DATA_TYPE_]), device=torch.device('cuda'))
         268	            self.dest_o = self.fermion_out_eo[1]
         269
         270	        for i in range(1, len(self.lat_size_list)):
         271	            _null_vecs = _torch.randn(size=[self.dof_list[i], self.dof_list[i-1]] +
         272	                                      self.lat_size_list[i-1], dtype=self.dtype_list[i-1], device=self.device_list[i-1])
         273	            if self.with_cuda_qcu and i == 1:
         274	                def _bistabcg(b: torch.Tensor, tol: float = 1e-6, max_iter: int = 1000, x0:  Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, if_rtol: bool = False, verbose: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor:
         275	                    if if_rtol:
         276	                        _tol = tools.norm(b)*tol
         277	                    else:
         278	                        _tol = tol
         279	                    self.fermion_in_eo = tools.oooxyzt2poooxyzt(input_array=b)
         280	                    self.params[define._MAX_ITER_] = max_iter
         281	                    self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1
         282	                    self.argv[define._ATOL_] = _tol
         283	                    qcu.applyInitQcu(self.set_ptrs, self.params, self.argv)
         284	                    self._max_set_index = max(
         285	                        self._max_set_index, int(self.params[define._SET_INDEX_]))
         286	                    qcu.applyCloverBistabCgQcu(self.fermion_out_eo, self.fermion_in_eo, self.gauge_eo, self.clover_ee,  # type: ignore
         287	                                               self.clover_oo, self.clover_ee_inv, self.clover_oo_inv,  self.set_ptrs, self.params)  # type: ignore
         288	                    return tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(input_array=self.fermion_out_eo).reshape(b.shape)
         289	                bistabcg = _bistabcg
         290	            else:
         291	                bistabcg = None
         292	            _null_vecs = tools.give_null_vecs(
         293	                null_vecs=_null_vecs,
         294	                matvec=self.op_list[i-1].matvec,
         295	                bistabcg=bistabcg,
         296	                verbose=self.verbose).to(dtype=self.dtype_list[i], device=self.device_list[i])
         297	            self.nv_list.append(_null_vecs)
         298	            _local_ortho_null_vecs = tools.local_orthogonalize(
         299	                null_vecs=_null_vecs,
         300	                coarse_lat_size=self.lat_size_list[i],
         301	                verbose=self.verbose)
         302	            self.lonv_list.append(_local_ortho_null_vecs)
         303	            self.b_list.append(torch.zeros(
         304	                size=[self.dof_list[i]]+self.lat_size_list[i], dtype=self.dtype_list[i], device=self.device_list[i]))
         305	            self.op_list.append(dslash.operator(fine_hopping=self.op_list[i-1].hopping, fine_sitting=self.op_list[i -
         306	                                1].sitting, local_ortho_null_vecs=_local_ortho_null_vecs,  verbose=self.verbose))
         307	        comm.Barrier()
         308
         309	    def end(self):
         310	        """释放 C++ LatticeSet 资源（防多实例/重复调用显存泄漏 OOM）。
         311
         312	        init 创建的 LatticeSet（槽位 0.._max_set_index，含 _bistabcg 的
         313	        逆迭代实例）全部 applyEndQcu 释放；调用后实例不可再 solve。
         314	        """
         315	        if self.with_cuda_qcu and self._max_set_index >= 0:
         316	            for _idx in range(self._max_set_index + 1):
         317	                self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = _idx
         318	                try:
         319	                    qcu.applyEndQcu(self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         320	                except Exception:
         321	                    pass
         322	            self._max_set_index = -1
         323
         324	    def __del__(self):
         325	        # 隐式 GC 释放时机不可控：先同步设备再释放，减少与并发 C++ 操作的干扰。
         326	        # 多实例循环场景请显式 end() + del + gc.collect()（见 AGENTS.md）。
         327	        try:
         328	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
         329	            self.end()
         330	        except Exception:
         331	            pass
         332
         333	    def levels_back(self):
         334	        self.convergence_tol = 0
         335	        self.num_level = len(self.op_list) if len(
         336	            self.op_list) <= self.max_level else self.max_level
         337
         338	    def adaptive(self, iter: int = 0):
         339	        if self.convergence_tol > 3:
         340	            self.num_level = 1
         341	        if (iter+1)*2 < self.num_convergence_sample+1:
         342	            return
         343	        convergence_now = self.convergence_history[-1]
         344	        convergence_sample = self.convergence_history[-(
         345	            self.num_convergence_sample+1):-1]
         346	        count = 0
         347	        for convergence in convergence_sample:
         348	            if convergence < convergence_now:
         349	                count += 1
         350	        if count >= self.num_convergence_sample//2:
         351	            self.convergence_tol += 1
         352
         353	    def cycle(self, level: int = 0) -> torch.Tensor:
         354	        matvec = self.op_list[level].matvec
         355	        if self.with_cuda_qcu and level == 1:
         356	            def _coarse_matvec(src: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         357	                return self._coarse_dslash_cuda(src=src, level=level)
         358	            matvec = _coarse_matvec
         359	        b = self.b_list[level].clone()
         360	        if level == 0 and self.support_parity:
         361	            b_origin = b.clone()
         362	            b_eo = tools.oooxyzt2poooxyzt(b)
         363	            b_e = b_eo[0]
         364	            b_o = b_eo[1]
         365	            b = self.op_list[0].give_b_parity(b_e=b_e, b_o=b_o)
         366	            if self.with_cuda_qcu is False:
         367	                matvec = self.op_list[0].matvec_parity
         368	            else:
         369	                def _matvec(src_o: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         370	                    self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         371	                    qcu.applyCloverBistabCgDslashQcu(self.dest_o, src_o, self.gauge_eo,
         372	                                                     self.clover_ee, self.clover_oo, self.clover_ee_inv, self.clover_oo_inv,  self.set_ptrs, self.params)  # type: ignore
         373	                    torch.cuda.synchronize()  # C++ 私有流完成后再读固定缓冲
         374	                    return self.dest_o.reshape(src_o.shape)
         375	                matvec = _matvec
         376	        x = torch.zeros_like(b)
         377	        r = b - matvec(x)
         378	        r_norm = tools.norm(r)
         379	        _tol = r_norm*0.5 if level != self.num_level - 1 else r_norm*0.1
         380	        if self.verbose:
         381	            print(
         382	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n {level}:Norm of b:{tools.norm(b)}")
         383	            print(f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n {level}:Norm of r:{r_norm}")
         384	            print(
         385	                f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n {level}:Norm of x0:{tools.norm(x)}")
         386	        if level == 0:
         387	            self.convergence_history.append(r_norm)
         388	            _tol = self.tol
         389	        if r_norm < _tol:
         390	            print("PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID:\n x0 is just right!")
         391	            return x
         392	        r_tilde = r.clone()
         393	        p = torch.zeros_like(b)
         394	        v = torch.zeros_like(b)
         395	        s = torch.zeros_like(b)
         396	        t = torch.zeros_like(b)
         397	        rho = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=b.dtype, device=b.device)
         398	        rho_prev = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=b.dtype, device=b.device)
         399	        alpha = torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=b.dtype, device=b.device)

         171	def _setup_gpu_tensors(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, device, mass, atol, dt, seed=42,
         172	                       verbose=False):
         173	    """在指定设备上生成规范场/Clover 项/源（C++ 后端）。
         174
         175	    返回 (g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa)。
         176	    """
         177	    params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         178	    params_t[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0
         179	    params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         180	    params_t[define._DAGGER_] = 0
         181	    params_t[define._MAX_ITER_] = 1000
         182	    params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 1 if verbose else 0
         183	    params_t[define._SEED_] = seed
         184	    params_t[define._TEST_IN_CPU_] = 0
         185	    av = argv_t.to(dtype=define.dtype(define.epytd(dt)).to_real())
         186	    av[define._MASS_] = mass
         187	    av[define._ATOL_] = atol
         188	    av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1
         189	    ls = define.lat_shape(params_t)
         190	    # P100(sm_60) 兼容：torch 2.10 无 sm_60 kernel image，zeros/randn 填充内核
         191	    # 在 P100 上失败并污染 CUDA 错误状态；empty（纯 cudaMalloc）与 CPU 生成 +
         192	    # H2D 拷贝（driver memcpy）均可用。C++ 后端会写满 g/ce/coo 等输出缓冲。
         193	    g = torch.empty([2, 3, 3, 4] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         194	    fi = torch.randn([2, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device='cpu').to(device)
         195	    ce = torch.empty([4, 3, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=dt, device=device)
         196	    cei = torch.empty_like(ce); coo = torch.empty_like(ce); coi = torch.empty_like(ce)
         197	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = -1
         198	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyGaussGaugeQcu(g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         199	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 0
         200	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(ce, cei, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         201	    params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] += 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; params_t[define._PARITY_] = 1
         202	    qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, av); qcu.applyCloversQcu(coo, coi, g, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         203	    U_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g)
         204	    b_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(fi)
         205	    kappa = 1.0 / (2 * mass + 8)
         206	    clover_full = dslash.make_clover(U_full, kappa=kappa)
         207	    return g, fi, ce, cei, coo, coi, U_full, b_full, clover_full, kappa, av

         547	    def save_report(self, path: str):
         548	        """导出求解报告（JSON：配置/每线程耗时/残差/一致性）。"""
         549	        import json
         550	        if self._results is None:
         551	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         552	        rep = dict(self._results)
         553	        rep['threads'] = [{k: (float(v) if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.numel() == 1
         554	                               else (v.tolist() if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.numel() <= 16
         555	                                     else (f"<tensor{v.shape}>" if torch.is_tensor(v) else v)))
         556	                           for k, v in t.items()} for t in rep['threads']]
         557	        rep['device_ids'] = list(rep['device_ids'])
         558	        rep['dof_list'] = list(rep['dof_list'])
         559	        rep['lat_size'] = list(rep['lat_size'])
         560	        with open(path, 'w') as f:
         561	            json.dump(rep, f, indent=2)
         562	        print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n report saved to {path}")
         563
         564	    def verify_consistency(self, tol: float = 1e-5) -> dict:
         565	        """校验各线程解与线程 0 解（参考）的一致性（相对误差 < tol）。"""
         566	        if self._results is None:
         567	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         568	        threads = self._results['threads']
         569	        ref = threads[0]['mg']
         570	        checks = []
         571	        for t in threads:
         572	            rel = float((t['mg'] - ref).abs().max() / (ref.abs().max() + 1e-30))
         573	            checks.append({'tid': t['tid'], 'device': t['device'],
         574	                           'rel_max_diff': rel, 'pass': rel < tol})
         575	        all_pass = all(c['pass'] for c in checks)
         576	        summary = {'tol': tol, 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all_pass}
         577	        if self.verbose:
         578	            print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n consistency verify (tol={tol}): "
         579	                  f"{'PASS' if all_pass else 'FAIL'}")
         580	            for c in checks:
         581	                print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n   tid={c['tid']} device={c['device']} "
         582	                      f"rel_max_diff={c['rel_max_diff']:.3e}")
         583	        return summary
         584

         586	def verify_multi_gpu_mg(**kwargs):
         587	    """一行式验证入口（供 pyqcu.testing / examples 使用）。
         588
         589	    kwargs 透传 MultiGpuMultigrid（lat_size/mass/atol/nthreads/...）。
         590	    返回 (results, consistency)。
         591	    """
         592	    mg = MultiGpuMultigrid(**kwargs)
         593	    results = mg.solve()
         594	    consistency = mg.verify_consistency(tol=kwargs.get('tol', 1e-5))
         595	    return results, consistency

         144	            self._mg_prolong_out, coarse_vec, lonv, self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         145	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         146	        return self._mg_prolong_out

         148	    def _coarse_dslash_cuda(self, src: torch.Tensor, level: int) -> torch.Tensor:
         149	        """CUDA-accelerated coarse-grid dslash using C++ backend.
         150
         151	        Applies the coarse-grid Dirac operator D_coarse = sitting + hopping_plus + hopping_minus.
         152	        Data layout:
         153	          - fermion:  [E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         154	          - hopping:  [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc] (pm × dir × Eout × Ein × XYZT)
         155	          - sitting:  [E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         156	        """
         157	        op = self.op_list[level]
         158	        E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = src.shape
         159	        # NOTE: SET_INDEX_ is reset to 0 for coarse dslash. This is safe because
         160	        # the coarse dslash operates at a different multigrid level and does not
         161	        # overlap with fine-level BiCGStab iterations that increment SET_INDEX_.
         162	        # If coarse dslash were ever called concurrently with fine-level ops,
         163	        # a dedicated SET_INDEX_ per level would be required.
         164	        self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0
         165	        # Pack hopping matrices: [2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc]
         166	        # dim0: 0=plus, 1=minus; dim1: 0=X, 1=Y, 2=Z, 3=T
         167	        target_shape = torch.Size([2, 4, E, E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc])
         168	        if (self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed is None or
         169	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.shape != target_shape or
         170	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed.device != src.device or
         171	                self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level != level):
         172	            hopping_packed = torch.zeros(
         173	                target_shape, dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         174	            for ward in range(4):
         175	                hopping_packed[0, ward] = op.hopping.M_plus_list[ward].to(
         176	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         177	                hopping_packed[1, ward] = op.hopping.M_minus_list[ward].to(
         178	                    dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         179	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed = hopping_packed
         180	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed_level = level
         181	        # Set multigrid params for the C++ backend
         182	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Xc
         183	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Yc
         184	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Zc
         185	        self.params[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Tc
         186	        self.params[define._MG_NUM_LEVEL_] = E  # coarse DOF (repurposed)
         187	        # Ensure sitting tensor is on the correct device and dtype
         188	        sitting = op.sitting.M.to(dtype=src.dtype, device=src.device)
         189	        # Allocate or reuse output tensor
         190	        if (self._mg_coarse_dslash_out is None or
         191	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.shape != src.shape or
         192	                self._mg_coarse_dslash_out.device != src.device):
         193	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out = torch.zeros_like(src)
         194	        qcu.applyMultigridCoarseDslashQcu(
         195	            self._mg_coarse_dslash_out, src,
         196	            self._mg_coarse_hopping_packed, sitting,
         197	            self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         198	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         199	        return self._mg_coarse_dslash_out
         200
         201	    def _verify_coarse_dslash(self, level: int = 1, tol: float = 1e-3) -> bool:
         202	        """Debug helper: verify CUDA coarse dslash against Python einsum version.
         203
         204	        Generates random input, compares CUDA output with Python reference.
         205	        Returns True if max absolute difference < tol.
         206	        """
         207	        op = self.op_list[level]
         208	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = self.lat_size_list[level]
         209	        E = self.dof_list[level]
         210	        dtype = self.dtype_list[level]
         211	        device = self.device_list[level]
         212	        src = torch.randn([E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc], dtype=dtype, device=device)
         213	        # Python reference (einsum-based)
         214	        ref = op.matvec(src)
         215	        # CUDA path
         216	        cu = self._coarse_dslash_cuda(src, level=level)
         217	        diff = (ref - cu).abs().max().item()
         218	        if self.rank == self.root:
         219	            print(f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::VERIFY:\n "
         220	                  f"level={level}, max|ref-cuda| = {diff:.6e}")
         221	        return diff < tol

         312	        init 创建的 LatticeSet（槽位 0.._max_set_index，含 _bistabcg 的
         313	        逆迭代实例）全部 applyEndQcu 释放；调用后实例不可再 solve。
         314	        """

         316	            for _idx in range(self._max_set_index + 1):

         322	            self._max_set_index = -1

         326	        # 多实例循环场景请显式 end() + del + gc.collect()（见 AGENTS.md）。
         327	        try:
         328	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
         329	            self.end()
         330	        except Exception:
         331	            pass

         339	        if self.convergence_tol > 3:
         340	            self.num_level = 1
         341	        if (iter+1)*2 < self.num_convergence_sample+1:

         344	        convergence_sample = self.convergence_history[-(
         345	            self.num_convergence_sample+1):-1]
         346	        count = 0
         347	        for convergence in convergence_sample:
         348	            if convergence < convergence_now:
         349	                count += 1
         350	        if count >= self.num_convergence_sample//2:
         351	            self.convergence_tol += 1

         547	    def save_report(self, path: str):

         555	                                     else (f"<tensor{v.shape}>" if torch.is_tensor(v) else v)))
