         564	    def verify_consistency(self, tol: float = 1e-5) -> dict:
         565	        """校验各线程解与线程 0 解（参考）的一致性（相对误差 < tol）。"""
         566	        if self._results is None:
         567	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         568	        threads = self._results['threads']
         569	        ref = threads[0]['mg']
         570	        checks = []
         571	        for t in threads:
         572	            rel = float((t['mg'] - ref).abs().max() / (ref.abs().max() + 1e-30))
         573	            checks.append({'tid': t['tid'], 'device': t['device'],
         574	                           'rel_max_diff': rel, 'pass': rel < tol})
         575	        all_pass = all(c['pass'] for c in checks)
         576	        summary = {'tol': tol, 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all_pass}
         577	        if self.verbose:
         578	            print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n consistency verify (tol={tol}): "
         579	                  f"{'PASS' if all_pass else 'FAIL'}")
         580	            for c in checks:
         581	                print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n   tid={c['tid']} device={c['device']} "
         582	                      f"rel_max_diff={c['rel_max_diff']:.3e}")
         583	        return summary

         586	def verify_multi_gpu_mg(**kwargs):
         587	    """一行式验证入口（供 pyqcu.testing / examples 使用）。
         588
         589	    kwargs 透传 MultiGpuMultigrid（lat_size/mass/atol/nthreads/...）。
         590	    返回 (results, consistency)。
         591	    """
         592	    mg = MultiGpuMultigrid(**kwargs)
         593	    results = mg.solve()
         594	    consistency = mg.verify_consistency(tol=kwargs.get('tol', 1e-5))
         595	    return results, consistency

         284	        Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt = self.lat_size
         285	        params_t[define._LAT_X_] = Lx; params_t[define._LAT_Y_] = Ly
         286	        params_t[define._LAT_Z_] = Lz; params_t[define._LAT_T_] = Lt

         289	        # 多卡并行通过线程×卡绑定实现，不依赖 MPI 通信。
         290	        params_t[define._GRID_X_], params_t[define._GRID_Y_], \

         293	        params_t[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
         294	        params_t[define._DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         295	        # mass/atol/sigma 必须显式设置（模块级 argv 默认 mass=-3.5 会奇异）
         296	        av[define._MASS_] = self.mass
         297	        av[define._ATOL_] = self.atol
         298	        av[define._SIGMA_] = 0.1

         302	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_X_] = Lx // self.mg_grid[0]
         303	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Y_] = Ly // self.mg_grid[1]
         304	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_Z_] = Lz // self.mg_grid[2]
         305	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_T_] = Lt // (2 * self.mg_grid[3])
         306	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_MAX_ITER_] = self.coarse_max_iter
         307	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         308	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL1_NUM_RESTART_] = self.num_restart

         311	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_X_] = Lx // (self.mg_grid[0] * self.mg_grid[0])
         312	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Y_] = Ly // (self.mg_grid[1] * self.mg_grid[1])
         313	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_Z_] = Lz // (self.mg_grid[2] * self.mg_grid[2])
         314	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_T_] = Lt // (4 * self.mg_grid[3])
         315	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_MAX_ITER_] = 200
         316	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_DATA_TYPE_] = define.epytd(self.dt)
         317	            params_t[define._MG_LEVEL2_NUM_RESTART_] = 3
         318	        av[define._MG_LEVEL1_ATOL_] = self.atol * self.coarse_tol_factor
         319	        if self.num_levels >= 3:
         320	            av[define._MG_LEVEL2_ATOL_] = self.atol * self.coarse_tol_factor

         322	    def _worker(self, tid, shared):
         323	        """单线程完整 MG 流程（绑定 device_ids[tid % n]）。
         324
         325	        independent_problems=True 时每线程独立生成规范场/Clover/源与粗算子
         326	        （每线程不同 seed），无共享状态 —— 多卡吞吐并行模式；
         327	        否则共享输入 + 每线程拷贝（一致性验证模式）。
         328	        """
         329	        dev_id = self.device_ids[tid % len(self.device_ids)]
         330	        torch.cuda.set_device(dev_id)
         331	        dev = torch.device(f'cuda:{dev_id}')
         332	        params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t = _clone_state()
         333	        self._config_params(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, argv_t)
         334	        if self.independent_problems:
         335	            # 独立问题：规范场/Clover/源与粗算子由主线程在 V100 预构建
         336	            # （P100 无 torch kernel image，粗算子构建的 torch 运算只能在 V100
         337	            # 完成），本线程只做 D2D 拷贝 + C++ 求解。
         338	            st = shared['t'][tid]
         339	            g = st['g'].to(dev); fi = st['fi'].to(dev)
         340	            ce = st['ce'].to(dev); cei = st['cei'].to(dev)
         341	            coo = st['coo'].to(dev); coi = st['coi'].to(dev)
         342	            coarse = st['coarse']
         343	        else:
         344	            # 共享输入（规范场/Clover/源）拷贝到本卡
         345	            g = shared['g'].to(dev); fi = shared['fi'].to(dev)
         346	            ce = shared['ce'].to(dev); cei = shared['cei'].to(dev)
         347	            coo = shared['coo'].to(dev); coi = shared['coi'].to(dev)
         348	            coarse = shared['coarse']
         349	        # 2026-08-20 dev80 fix: 共享/独立模式均由主线程在 V100 预生成 gauge/clover 并拷贝，
         350	        # worker 不再本地重新生成（P100 sm_60 上 GaussGauge/BiStabCG 内核缺 image 且浪费显存）。
         351	        # 原逻辑共享模式每 worker 重跑 GaussGauge（seed 一致）+ 2 次 Clovers（各需 LatticeSet scratch），
         352	        # 在 32^4 上每 worker 额外 ~3GB scratch 且 P100 上直接 no kernel image。
         353	        # 现改为零拷贝复用：g/ce/coo 均为 V100 预生成后 D2D 拷贝到本卡，worker 仅需 BiStabCG/MG 的 plan1 LatticeSet。
         354	        # 若需独立 gauge 演化，改为主线程按 seed=42+tid 预生成（solve() 独立分支已做）。
         355	        pass  # gauge/clover 已由主线程生成并拷贝，无需 worker 本地重建
         356	        # 保留占位以保持 set_ptrs 槽位计数与旧逻辑兼容（但不再 init 0/1/2）
         357	        # 粗网格算子拷贝到本卡，填入 set_ptrs 槽位
         358	        # 注意：.to(dev) 在跨设备时产生新张量，必须保留引用（_coarse_dev），
         359	        # 否则临时对象被 GC 回收后 data_ptr 悬垂，C++ 求解读到垃圾（nan）。
         360	        _coarse_dev = []
         361	        for fl, (lonv, hnn, hdg, sit) in enumerate(coarse):
         362	            base = _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4 * fl
         363	            lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d = (lonv.to(dev).contiguous(),
         364	                                           hnn.to(dev).contiguous(),
         365	                                           hdg.to(dev).contiguous(),
         366	                                           sit.to(dev).contiguous())
         367	            _coarse_dev.extend([lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d])
         368	            set_ptrs_t[base + 0] = lonv_d.data_ptr()
         369	            set_ptrs_t[base + 1] = hnn_d.data_ptr()
         370	            set_ptrs_t[base + 2] = hdg_d.data_ptr()

         201	    def _verify_coarse_dslash(self, level: int = 1, tol: float = 1e-3) -> bool:
         202	        """Debug helper: verify CUDA coarse dslash against Python einsum version.
         203
         204	        Generates random input, compares CUDA output with Python reference.
         205	        Returns True if max absolute difference < tol.
         206	        """
         207	        op = self.op_list[level]
         208	        Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc = self.lat_size_list[level]
         209	        E = self.dof_list[level]
         210	        dtype = self.dtype_list[level]
         211	        device = self.device_list[level]
         212	        src = torch.randn([E, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc], dtype=dtype, device=device)
         213	        # Python reference (einsum-based)
         214	        ref = op.matvec(src)
         215	        # CUDA path
         216	        cu = self._coarse_dslash_cuda(src, level=level)
         217	        diff = (ref - cu).abs().max().item()
         218	        if self.rank == self.root:
         219	            print(f"PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::VERIFY:\n "
         220	                  f"level={level}, max|ref-cuda| = {diff:.6e}")
         221	        return diff < tol

         223	    def init(self):
         224	        # Build local-orthonormal near-null space vectors
         225	        comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
         226	        comm.Barrier()

         228	            from pyqcu.cuda.define import params, argv, set_ptrs
         229	            params[define._LAT_X_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_X_]
         230	            params[define._LAT_Y_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_Y_]
         231	            params[define._LAT_Z_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_Z_]
         232	            params[define._LAT_T_] = self.lat_size[define._LAT_T_]
         233	            params[define._LAT_XYZT_] = params[define._LAT_X_] * \
         234	                params[define._LAT_Y_]*params[define._LAT_Z_] * \
         235	                params[define._LAT_T_]
         236	            params[define._GRID_X_], params[define._GRID_Y_], params[define._GRID_Z_], params[
         237	                define._GRID_T_] = tools.give_grid_size()

         338	    def adaptive(self, iter: int = 0):

         344	        convergence_sample = self.convergence_history[-(
         345	            self.num_convergence_sample+1):-1]
         346	        count = 0
         347	        for convergence in convergence_sample:
         348	            if convergence < convergence_now:
         349	                count += 1
         350	        if count >= self.num_convergence_sample//2:
         351	            self.convergence_tol += 1

         547	    def save_report(self, path: str):

         554	                               else (v.tolist() if torch.is_tensor(v) and v.numel() <= 16
         555	                                     else (f"<tensor{v.shape}>" if torch.is_tensor(v) else v)))
         556	                           for k, v in t.items()} for t in rep['threads']]
         557	        rep['device_ids'] = list(rep['device_ids'])
         558	        rep['dof_list'] = list(rep['dof_list'])
         559	        rep['lat_size'] = list(rep['lat_size'])
         560	        with open(path, 'w') as f:

         564	    def verify_consistency(self, tol: float = 1e-5) -> dict:
         565	        """校验各线程解与线程 0 解（参考）的一致性（相对误差 < tol）。"""
         566	        if self._results is None:
         567	            raise RuntimeError("PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n call solve() first")
         568	        threads = self._results['threads']
         569	        ref = threads[0]['mg']
         570	        checks = []
         571	        for t in threads:
         572	            rel = float((t['mg'] - ref).abs().max() / (ref.abs().max() + 1e-30))
         573	            checks.append({'tid': t['tid'], 'device': t['device'],
         574	                           'rel_max_diff': rel, 'pass': rel < tol})
         575	        all_pass = all(c['pass'] for c in checks)
         576	        summary = {'tol': tol, 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all_pass}
         577	        if self.verbose:
         578	            print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n consistency verify (tol={tol}): "
         579	                  f"{'PASS' if all_pass else 'FAIL'}")
         580	            for c in checks:
         581	                print(f"PYQCU::CUDA::MULTI_GPU:\n   tid={c['tid']} device={c['device']} "
         582	                      f"rel_max_diff={c['rel_max_diff']:.3e}")
         583	        return summary

         586	def verify_multi_gpu_mg(**kwargs):
         587	    """一行式验证入口（供 pyqcu.testing / examples 使用）。
         588
         589	    kwargs 透传 MultiGpuMultigrid（lat_size/mass/atol/nthreads/...）。
         590	    返回 (results, consistency)。
         591	    """
         592	    mg = MultiGpuMultigrid(**kwargs)
         593	    results = mg.solve()
         594	    consistency = mg.verify_consistency(tol=kwargs.get('tol', 1e-5))
         595	    return results, consistency

          27	class _SetIndexAllocator:
          28	    """全局 set_index 槽位分配器（线程安全，带槽位回收）。
          29
          30	    每个 CudaSchurOp/CudaCoarseSchurOp 实例在各自的 set_ptrs 副本中独占
          31	    一个槽位（_SET_INDEX_ 对应 set_ptrs[_SET_INDEX_] = LatticeSet*）。
          32	    set_ptrs 为 int64[100]：槽位必须避开粗算子区
          33	    （_SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_=30 起），上限 MAX_SLOTS=24。
          34	    实例 release() 时归还槽位供复用 —— 长时间循环（bench/sweep 逐配置
          35	    创建/释放实例）下槽位 = 同时活跃实例数，不会累积越界
          36	    （历史 BUG：单调递增不回收，20+ 配置后 set_index>100 → C++ 端
          37	    set_ptrs[set_index] 越界写堆 → applyEndQcu free 崩溃）。
          38	    """
          39
          40	    MAX_SLOTS = 24
          41
          42	    def __init__(self):
          43	        self._counter = 0
          44	        self._free = []
          45	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
          46
          47	    def next(self) -> int:
          48	        with self._lock:
          49	            if self._free:
          50	                return self._free.pop()
          51	            if self._counter >= self.MAX_SLOTS:
          52	                raise RuntimeError(
          53	                    "PYQCU::CUDA::SCHUR_OP:\n set_index 槽位耗尽（MAX_SLOTS=%d），"
          54	                    "存在未 release 的算子实例（泄漏）" % self.MAX_SLOTS)
          55	            self._counter += 1
          56	            return self._counter
          57
          58	    def free(self, idx):
          59	        """归还槽位（实例 release() 后调用）。"""
          60	        with self._lock:
          61	            if idx not in self._free and idx <= self._counter:
          62	                self._free.append(idx)
          63
          64
          65	_GLOBAL_SET_ALLOC = _SetIndexAllocator()

          68	class CudaSchurOp(object):
          69	    """C++ CUDA 实现的 Schur 奇偶算子（matvec_parity 等价物）。
          70
          71	    matvec(x_o) -> y_o：x_o/y_o 为 [12,X,Y,Z,T/2] 奇子格场。
          72	    构造即分配独立 LatticeSet（scratch 缓冲）；release() 释放。
          73
          74	    参数：
          75	        av: argv 张量（float，real dtype，长度 7）
          76	        g:  gauge 场 [2,3,3,4,X,Y,Z,T/2]（奇偶拆分）
          77	        ce/coo: Clover 偶偶/奇奇项
          78	        cei/coi: Clover 偶偶/奇奇逆
          79	        device: 绑定的 torch 设备（多线程多卡模式下每线程一个 device）
          80	    """
          81
          82	    def __init__(self, av, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, device=None, params=None):
          83	        self.device = device if device is not None else torch.device('cuda')
          84	        if params is not None:
          85	            self.params = params.clone()
          86	        else:
          87	            self.params = _module_params.clone()
          88	        self.params[define._SET_INDEX_] = _GLOBAL_SET_ALLOC.next()
          89	        self.set_index = int(self.params[define._SET_INDEX_])
          90	        self.params[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
          91	        self.params[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
          92	        # 独立 set_ptrs 副本：多线程各持一份，互不干扰
          93	        self.set_ptrs = _module_set_ptrs.clone()
          94	        self._g, self._ce, self._coo, self._cei, self._coi = g, ce, coo, cei, coi
          95	        self._y_buf = None
          96	        self._y_buf_shape = None
          97	        qcu.applyInitQcu(self.set_ptrs, self.params, av)
          98
          99	    def matvec(self, x_o):
         100	        # 输入/输出必须连续：桥函数 .contiguous() 会拷贝，若输出非连续则
         101	        # C++ 写入副本、原张量内容不变（垃圾）导致求解错误。
         102	        x_c = x_o.contiguous()
         103	        # C++ 输出写预分配固定缓冲（不经过 torch 分配器，避免池复用与
         104	        # C++ 私有流之间的深层竞争——实测 torch 池复用时偶发结果错误）；
         105	        # 设备级同步保证 C++ 私有流完成，再 clone 到新张量（默认流语义）。
         106	        if self._y_buf is None or self._y_buf_shape != tuple(x_c.shape):
         107	            self._y_buf = torch.empty_like(x_c)
         108	            self._y_buf_shape = tuple(x_c.shape)
         109	        torch.cuda.current_stream().synchronize()
         110	        qcu.applyCloverBistabCgDslashQcu(
         111	            self._y_buf, x_c, self._g, self._ce, self._coo, self._cei, self._coi,
         112	            self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         113	        torch.cuda.synchronize()
         114	        return self._y_buf.clone()
         115
         116	    def release(self):
         117	        """释放本实例 scratch：用本实例 params/set_ptrs 调 applyEndQcu。
         118
         119	        注意 applyEndQcu 释放 set_ptrs 中该槽位对应的 LatticeSet。
         120	        """
         121	        qcu.applyEndQcu(self.set_ptrs, self.params)
         122	        _GLOBAL_SET_ALLOC.free(self.set_index)
         123	        self.set_index = None
         124
         125	    def __del__(self):
         126	        try:
         127	            if self.set_index is not None:
         128	                self.release()
         129	        except Exception:
         130	            pass

      # dev87 对照环境：优先解析本任务构建的 libquda（LD_LIBRARY_PATH 前缀压过全局旧库）
      export QUDA_INSTALL=/tmp/opencode/quda-install
      export QUDA_PATH=$QUDA_INSTALL
      export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$QUDA_INSTALL/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
      export DEV87_REDUCE_SYNC=1
      """dev87 公共设施：设备选择、统一 gauge/nullvec 加载、PyQCU<->QDP 布局转换、结果落盘。
      
      数据约定（继承 dev84）：data/gauge_{lat}_m{mass}_seed{seed}_c64.h5 的
        g  = [2(parity),3,3,4,x,y,z,T/2] c64（奇偶压缩布局，t 方向对半）
        fi = [2,4,3,x,y,z,T/2] c64（随机源场）
      GPU 规约（v20260825 指令17）：单卡测试用 V100-32GB；多卡测试用 P100×2。
      """
      import json
      import os
      import time
      from pathlib import Path
      
      import numpy as np
      import torch
      
      from pyqcu import tools
      import pyqcu.cuda.define as define
      from pyqcu.cuda.define import params as mod_params, argv as mod_argv, set_ptrs as mod_set_ptrs
      from pyqcu.cuda import qcu
      
      REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
      DATA_DIR = REPO / "data"
      OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out"
      LAT_DEFAULT = [16, 32, 32, 48]
      MASS_DEFAULT = 0.05
      ATOL_DEFAULT = 1e-6
      SIGMA_DEFAULT = 0.1
      SEED_DEFAULT = 42
      
      
      def pick_v100():
          """按 v20260825 指令17 选 V100-32GB；QCU_DEVICE_ID 可显式覆盖。"""
          env = os.environ.get("QCU_DEVICE_ID")
          if env is not None:
              i = int(env); torch.cuda.set_device(i)
              return i
          for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count()):
              if "V100" in torch.cuda.get_device_name(i):
                  torch.cuda.set_device(i)
                  return i
          raise RuntimeError("V100 not found")
      
      
      def gauge_tag(lat, mass, seed=SEED_DEFAULT):
          return f"gauge_{lat[0]}x{lat[1]}x{lat[2]}x{lat[3]}_m{mass}_seed{seed}_c64.h5"
      
      
      def nv_tag(lat, E, nvi, suf=""):
          return f"L{lat[0]}x{lat[1]}x{lat[2]}x{lat[3]}_lv1_E{E}_nvi{nvi}{suf}_t1e-2.h5"
      
      
      def load_gauge_h5(lat, mass=MASS_DEFAULT, seed=SEED_DEFAULT, device="cuda"):
          """读 data/*.h5 -> g_dev[2,3,3,4,x,y,z,T/2]。"""
          import h5py
          path = DATA_DIR / gauge_tag(lat, mass, seed)
          if not path.exists():
              raise FileNotFoundError(path)
          with h5py.File(str(path), "r") as f:
              g_np = f["g"][...]
          return torch.from_numpy(g_np).to(device)
      
      
      def load_stencil(lat, E=12, nvi=1, suf="", device="cuda"):
          """读 data/*_lv1_*.h5 -> (lonv,hnn,hdg,sit) 33-tensor 粗算子资产。"""
          path = DATA_DIR / nv_tag(lat, E, nvi, suf)
          if not path.exists():
              raise FileNotFoundError(path)
          return tuple(tools.load_tensor_h5(str(path), dataset=k, device=device)
                       for k in ("lonv", "hnn", "hdg", "sit"))
      
      
      def full_gauge_numpy(g_dev):
          """PyQCU 奇偶布局 -> 全格点 numpy [3,3,4,X,Y,Z,T]。"""
          U_full = tools.poooxyzt2oooxyzt(g_dev)
          return U_full.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy()
      
      
      def full_to_qdp(u_full):
          """全格点 [3,3,4,X,Y,Z,T] -> QDP 序 numpy (4,Lt,Lz,Ly,Lx,3,3)（供 pyquda loadGauge）。
      
          色指标行/列次序与 dagger 约定的最终核对由 cmp_dslash 数值对照闭环裁决。
          """
          u = np.asarray(u_full)
          u = np.ascontiguousarray(np.transpose(u, (2, 6, 5, 4, 3, 0, 1)))
          return u
      
      
      def make_clover_tensors(g_dev, lat, mass=MASS_DEFAULT):
          """经 C++ applyCloversQcu 构建 (ce,cei,coo,coi)。调用方负责生命周期。"""
          p = mod_params.clone()
          a = mod_argv.clone()
          s = mod_set_ptrs.clone()
          dt = define._LAT_C64_
          Lx, Ly, Lz, Lt = lat
          p[define._LAT_X_] = Lx; p[define._LAT_Y_] = Ly; p[define._LAT_Z_] = Lz; p[define._LAT_T_] = Lt
          p[define._LAT_XYZT_] = Lx * Ly * Lz * Lt
          p[define._GRID_X_] = p[define._GRID_Y_] = p[define._GRID_Z_] = p[define._GRID_T_] = 1
          p[define._NODE_RANK_] = 0; p[define._NODE_SIZE_] = 1
          p[define._DATA_TYPE_] = dt
          av = a.to(dtype=define.dtype(dt).to_real())
          av[define._MASS_] = mass; av[define._SIGMA_] = SIGMA_DEFAULT
          ls = define.lat_shape(p)
          ce = torch.empty([4, 3, 4, 3] + ls, dtype=torch.complex64, device=g_dev.device)
          cei = torch.empty_like(ce); coo = torch.empty_like(ce); coi = torch.empty_like(ce)
          idx = int(p[define._SET_INDEX_].item())
          p[define._SET_INDEX_] = idx; p[define._SET_PLAN_] = 2; p[define._PARITY_] = 0
          qcu.applyInitQcu(s, p, av)
          qcu.applyCloversQcu(ce, cei, g_dev, s, p)
          p[define._SET_INDEX_] = idx + 1; p[define._PARITY_] = 1
          qcu.applyInitQcu(s, p, av)
          qcu.applyCloversQcu(coo, coi, g_dev, s, p)
          for j in (idx, idx + 1):
              p[define._SET_INDEX_] = j
              qcu.applyEndQcu(s, p)
          p[define._SET_INDEX_] = idx + 2
          return ce, cei, coo, coi, s, p, av
      
      
      def save_result(name, payload):
          OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          path = OUT_DIR / f"{name}.json"
          payload = dict(payload)
          payload["ts"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
          with open(path, "w") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=float)
          print(f"[result] {path}")
          return path

         322	    def _worker(self, tid, shared):
         323	        """单线程完整 MG 流程（绑定 device_ids[tid % n]）。
         324
         325	        independent_problems=True 时每线程独立生成规范场/Clover/源与粗算子
         326	        （每线程不同 seed），无共享状态 —— 多卡吞吐并行模式；
         327	        否则共享输入 + 每线程拷贝（一致性验证模式）。
         328	        """
         329	        dev_id = self.device_ids[tid % len(self.device_ids)]
         330	        torch.cuda.set_device(dev_id)
         331	        dev = torch.device(f'cuda:{dev_id}')
         332	        params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t = _clone_state()
         333	        self._config_params(params_t, argv_t, set_ptrs_t, argv_t)
         334	        if self.independent_problems:
         335	            # 独立问题：规范场/Clover/源与粗算子由主线程在 V100 预构建
         336	            # （P100 无 torch kernel image，粗算子构建的 torch 运算只能在 V100
         337	            # 完成），本线程只做 D2D 拷贝 + C++ 求解。
         338	            st = shared['t'][tid]
         339	            g = st['g'].to(dev); fi = st['fi'].to(dev)
         340	            ce = st['ce'].to(dev); cei = st['cei'].to(dev)
         341	            coo = st['coo'].to(dev); coi = st['coi'].to(dev)
         342	            coarse = st['coarse']
         343	        else:
         344	            # 共享输入（规范场/Clover/源）拷贝到本卡
         345	            g = shared['g'].to(dev); fi = shared['fi'].to(dev)
         346	            ce = shared['ce'].to(dev); cei = shared['cei'].to(dev)
         347	            coo = shared['coo'].to(dev); coi = shared['coi'].to(dev)
         348	            coarse = shared['coarse']
         349	        # 2026-08-20 dev80 fix: 共享/独立模式均由主线程在 V100 预生成 gauge/clover 并拷贝，
         350	        # worker 不再本地重新生成（P100 sm_60 上 GaussGauge/BiStabCG 内核缺 image 且浪费显存）。
         351	        # 原逻辑共享模式每 worker 重跑 GaussGauge（seed 一致）+ 2 次 Clovers（各需 LatticeSet scratch），
         352	        # 在 32^4 上每 worker 额外 ~3GB scratch 且 P100 上直接 no kernel image。
         353	        # 现改为零拷贝复用：g/ce/coo 均为 V100 预生成后 D2D 拷贝到本卡，worker 仅需 BiStabCG/MG 的 plan1 LatticeSet。
         354	        # 若需独立 gauge 演化，改为主线程按 seed=42+tid 预生成（solve() 独立分支已做）。
         355	        pass  # gauge/clover 已由主线程生成并拷贝，无需 worker 本地重建
         356	        # 保留占位以保持 set_ptrs 槽位计数与旧逻辑兼容（但不再 init 0/1/2）
         357	        # 粗网格算子拷贝到本卡，填入 set_ptrs 槽位
         358	        # 注意：.to(dev) 在跨设备时产生新张量，必须保留引用（_coarse_dev），
         359	        # 否则临时对象被 GC 回收后 data_ptr 悬垂，C++ 求解读到垃圾（nan）。
         360	        _coarse_dev = []
         361	        for fl, (lonv, hnn, hdg, sit) in enumerate(coarse):
         362	            base = _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4 * fl
         363	            lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d = (lonv.to(dev).contiguous(),
         364	                                           hnn.to(dev).contiguous(),
         365	                                           hdg.to(dev).contiguous(),
         366	                                           sit.to(dev).contiguous())
         367	            _coarse_dev.extend([lonv_d, hnn_d, hdg_d, sit_d])
         368	            set_ptrs_t[base + 0] = lonv_d.data_ptr()
         369	            set_ptrs_t[base + 1] = hnn_d.data_ptr()
         370	            set_ptrs_t[base + 2] = hdg_d.data_ptr()
         371	            set_ptrs_t[base + 3] = sit_d.data_ptr()
         372	        # 参考 BiStabCG（worker 仅需 plan1 的 2 个 LatticeSet，gauge/clover 已由主线程预生成并 D2D 拷贝）
         373	        params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 0; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         374	        params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
         375	        qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, argv_t)
         376	        fo_ref = torch.empty_like(fi)
         377	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); t0 = time.perf_counter()
         378	        qcu.applyCloverBistabCgQcu(fo_ref, fi, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         379	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); ref_time = time.perf_counter() - t0
         380	        # C++ Clover Multigrid
         381	        fo_mg = torch.empty_like(fi)
         382	        params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = 1; params_t[define._SET_PLAN_] = 1
         383	        params_t[define._VERBOSE_] = 0
         384	        qcu.applyInitQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t, argv_t)
         385	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); t0 = time.perf_counter()
         386	        qcu.applyCloverMultigridQcu(fo_mg, fi, g, ce, coo, cei, coi, set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         387	        torch.cuda.synchronize(); mg_time = time.perf_counter() - t0
         388	        # 释放本线程 LatticeSet（仅 0/BiStabCG 和 1/MG 两个槽位）
         389	        for _idx in (0, 1):
         390	            params_t[define._SET_INDEX_] = _idx
         391	            try:
         392	                qcu.applyEndQcu(set_ptrs_t, params_t)
         393	            except Exception:
         394	                pass
         395	        return {'tid': tid, 'device': dev_id, 'mg': fo_mg.cpu(), 'ref': fo_ref.cpu(),
         396	                'ref_time': ref_time, 'mg_time': mg_time}

           8	/**
           9	 * @brief C++ CUDA Clover Multigrid solver entry point.
          10	 *
          11	 * The set_ptrs array (int64[100]) is used to pass coarse-grid operator data
          12	 * using the following convention (SCHUR-consistent 33-tensor stencil):
          13	 *   set_ptrs[_SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4*fl + 0] = null_vecs  for fine level fl→fl+1
          14	 *   set_ptrs[_SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4*fl + 1] = hop_nn     for coarse level fl+1
          15	 *   set_ptrs[_SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4*fl + 2] = hop_diag   for coarse level fl+1
          16	 *   set_ptrs[_SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4*fl + 3] = sit_packed for coarse level fl+1
          17	 *
          18	 * where _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ = 30 (well past the LatticeSet slots; _SET_INDEX_ grows with each applyInitQcu, so the coarse-op slots must not collide with it) in set_ptrs after scratch ptrs).
          19	 */
          20	#define _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ 30
          21
          22	void applyCloverMultigridQcu(long long _fermion_out, long long _fermion_in,
          23	                              long long _gauge, long long _clover_ee,
          24	                              long long _clover_oo,

          34	  void *clover_oo = (void *)_clover_oo;
          35	  void *clover_ee_inv = (void *)_clover_ee_inv;
          36	  void *clover_oo_inv = (void *)_clover_oo_inv;
          37	  void *set_ptrs = (void *)_set_ptrs;
          38	  void *params = (void *)_params;
          39
          40	  int set_index = static_cast<int *>(params)[_SET_INDEX_];
          41	  int data_type = static_cast<int *>(params)[_DATA_TYPE_];
          42	  long long *sp = static_cast<long long *>(set_ptrs);
          43
          44	  if (data_type == _LAT_C64_) {
          45	    LatticeSet<float> *set_ptr =
          46	        static_cast<LatticeSet<float> *>((void *)(sp[set_index]));
          47	    LatticeCloverMultigrid<float> _multigrid;
          48	    _multigrid.give(set_ptr);

          50	    _multigrid.init(fermion_out, fermion_in, gauge, clover_ee, clover_oo,
          51	                    clover_ee_inv, clover_oo_inv);

          53	    double init_ms = std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(tb-ta).count();

          55	    // ---- Wire up coarse-grid operators from set_ptrs ----

          57	    // These must be set by the Python caller before calling this function.
          58	    int num_levels = set_ptr->host_params[_MG_NUM_LEVEL_];
          59	    for (int fl = 0; fl < num_levels - 1; fl++) {
          60	      int base = _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4 * fl;
          61	      void *nv = (void *)sp[base + 0];
          62	      void *hnn = (void *)sp[base + 1];
          63	      void *hdg = (void *)sp[base + 2];
          64	      void *sp_sit = (void *)sp[base + 3];
          65	      if (nv && hnn && hdg && sp_sit) {
          66	        _multigrid.set_coarse_ops(fl, nv, hnn, hdg, sp_sit);
          67	        if (set_ptr->host_params[_VERBOSE_] && set_ptr->host_params[_NODE_RANK_] == 0) {
          68	          printf("MG: set coarse ops level %d→%d: nv=%p, hop_nn=%p, hop_diag=%p, sit=%p\n",
          69	                 fl, fl+1, nv, hnn, hdg, sp_sit);
          70	        }
          71	      }
          72	    }
          73
          74	    if (set_ptr->host_params[_VERBOSE_]) {
          75	      printf("=== MULTIGRID VERBOSE MODE ===\n");
          76	      printf("num_levels: %d\n", num_levels);
          77	      printf("fermion_out: %lld\n", (long long)fermion_out);
          78	      printf("fermion_in: %lld\n", (long long)fermion_in);
          79	      printf("gauge: %lld\n", (long long)gauge);
          80	      printf("clover_ee: %lld\n", (long long)clover_ee);
          81	      printf("clover_oo: %lld\n", (long long)clover_oo);
          82	      printf("clover_ee_inv: %lld\n", (long long)clover_ee_inv);
          83	      printf("clover_oo_inv: %lld\n", (long long)clover_oo_inv);
          84	      _multigrid.run_test();
          85	    } else {
          86	      _multigrid.run();
          87	    }
          88	    auto tc = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
          89	    _multigrid.end();
          90	    auto td = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
          91	    double end_ms = std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(td-tc).count();
          92	    printf("MG init=%.1fms end=%.1fms solve=%.1fms\n", init_ms, end_ms, _multigrid.solve_time_ms);
          93	  } else if (data_type == _LAT_C128_) {
          94	    LatticeSet<double> *set_ptr =
          95	        static_cast<LatticeSet<double> *>((void *)(sp[set_index]));
          96	    LatticeCloverMultigrid<double> _multigrid;
          97	    _multigrid.give(set_ptr);
          98	    _multigrid.init(fermion_out, fermion_in, gauge, clover_ee, clover_oo,
          99	                    clover_ee_inv, clover_oo_inv);

         101	    // ---- Wire up coarse-grid operators from set_ptrs ----
         102	    int num_levels = set_ptr->host_params[_MG_NUM_LEVEL_];
         103	    for (int fl = 0; fl < num_levels - 1; fl++) {
         104	      int base = _SET_PTRS_COARSE_BASE_ + 4 * fl;
         105	      void *nv = (void *)sp[base + 0];
         106	      void *hnn = (void *)sp[base + 1];
         107	      void *hdg = (void *)sp[base + 2];
         108	      void *sp_sit = (void *)sp[base + 3];
         109	      if (nv && hnn && hdg && sp_sit) {
         110	        _multigrid.set_coarse_ops(fl, nv, hnn, hdg, sp_sit);
         111	        if (set_ptr->host_params[_VERBOSE_] && set_ptr->host_params[_NODE_RANK_] == 0) {
         112	          printf("MG: set coarse ops level %d→%d (double)\n", fl, fl+1);
         113	        }
         114	      }
         115	    }
         116
         117	    if (set_ptr->host_params[_VERBOSE_]) {
         118	      printf("=== MULTIGRID VERBOSE MODE (double) ===\n");
         119	      _multigrid.run_test();
         120	    } else {
         121	      _multigrid.run();
         122	    }
         123	    _multigrid.end();
         124	  } else {
         125	    printf("applyCloverMultigridQcu: unsupported data_type=%d\n", data_type);
         126	  }
         127	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
         128	}

           7	template <typename T> struct LatticeMultigridRestrict {
           8	  LatticeSet<T> *set_ptr;
           9	  cudaError_t err;
          10	  void give(LatticeSet<T> *_set_ptr) { set_ptr = _set_ptr; }
          11	  void run(void *coarse_out, void *fine_in, void *null_vecs, int E, int e,
          12	           int Xf, int Yf, int Zf, int Tf, int Xc, int Yc, int Zc, int Tc) {
          13	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->stream));
          14	    int total_output = E * Xc * Yc * Zc * Tc;
          15	    dim3 gridDim((total_output + _BLOCK_SIZE_ - 1) / _BLOCK_SIZE_);
          16	    dim3 blockDim(_BLOCK_SIZE_);
          17	    multigrid_restrict<T><<<gridDim, blockDim, 0, set_ptr->stream>>>(
          18	        coarse_out, fine_in, null_vecs, E, e, Xf, Yf, Zf, Tf, Xc, Yc, Zc, Tc);
          19	    err = cudaGetLastError();
          20	    checkCudaErrors(err);
          21	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->stream));
          22	  }
          23	};

         642	    }
         643	    int max_blocks = max_blocks_per_sm[cur_dev] * sm_count[cur_dev];
         644	    if (grid_sz > max_blocks) grid_sz = max_blocks;
         645	    if (rank==0 && verbose)
         646	      printf("MG: fused grid=%d (cap=%d, sm=%d, occ=%d/block) n=%d\n",
         647	             grid_sz, max_blocks, sm_count[cur_dev], max_blocks_per_sm[cur_dev], n);
         648	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemsetAsync(coarse_breakdown, 0, sizeof(int),
         649	                                    set_ptr->stream));
         650	    void *args[] = {
         651	        (void*)&st.x, (void*)&st.rhs, (void*)&st.r_tilde, (void*)&st.r,
         652	        (void*)&st.p, (void*)&st.v, (void*)&st.s, (void*)&st.t,
         653	        (void*)&sit_packed[lev-1], (void*)&hop_nn[lev-1],
         654	        (void*)&hop_diag[lev-1],
         655	        (void*)&E, (void*)&Xc, (void*)&Yc, (void*)&Zc, (void*)&Ltc,
         656	        (void*)&st.max_iter, (void*)&tol_factor, (void*)&coarse_partials,
         657	        (void*)&coarse_breakdown};
         658	    checkCudaErrors(cudaLaunchCooperativeKernel(
         659	        (const void*)multigrid_coarse_solve_cg<T,NT>,
         660	        dim3(grid_sz), dim3(NT), args, 0, set_ptr->stream));
         661	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->stream));
         662	    int breakdown = 0;
         663	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpy(&breakdown, coarse_breakdown, sizeof(int),
         664	                               cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
         665	    if (breakdown != 0) {
         666	      // A breakdown means that the coarse operator supplied by the caller is
         667	      // singular (or numerically unusable).  Discard the partial correction;
         668	      // the fine-level Krylov solve remains a valid fallback.
         669	      zero_c(st.x, lev);
         670	      checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->stream));
         671	      if (rank == 0) {
         672	        log_write<T>("PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::\n " +
         673	                         std::to_string(lev) +
         674	                         ": fused coarse solve breakdown; correction dropped",
         675	                     rank, true);
         676	      }
         677	    }
         678	    auto q1=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         679	    if (rank==0)
         680	      log_write<T>("PYQCU::SOLVER::MULTIGRID::\n "+std::to_string(lev)+
         681	        ": FUSED-PARALLEL coarse solve ("+std::to_string(E)+" dof, "+
         682	        std::to_string(Xc)+"x"+std::to_string(Yc)+"x"+std::to_string(Zc)+
         683	        "x"+std::to_string(Ltc)+", grid="+std::to_string(grid_sz)+") in "+
         684	        std::to_string(std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(q1-q0).count())+" ms",rank,true);
         685	    return breakdown == 0;
         686	  }

         688	  // ==================================================================
         689	  // FULL-site fine-level dslash (used for the level-0 solve).
         690	  //
         691	  // The level-0 solve matches pyqcu/solver/_multigrid.py with
         692	  // support_parity=False: we solve the FULL Clover-Wilson operator
         693	  //   D = [D_ee, -κ·H_eo]
         694	  //       [-κ·H_oe, D_oo]
         695	  // on full-site vectors [sc, X, Y, Z, T], NOT the even-odd preconditioned
         696	  // Schur complement.  This is what makes the V-cycle coarse correction
         697	  // effective (the coarse space captures the low modes of the full operator).
         698	  // ==================================================================
         699
         700	  /**
         701	   * @brief Convert a full-site vector to parity-split [2, sc, X, Y, Z, T/2].
         702	   * dst must be a scratch buffer of size 2*lat_4dim_SC.
         703	   */
         704	  void full_to_parity(void *dst, void *src) {
         705	    cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
         706	    int sc=_LAT_SC_, total=(int)levels[0].vol;
         707	    int X=levels[0].X, Y=levels[0].Y, Z=levels[0].Z;
         708	    int Lt_full=2*levels[0].Lt;
         709	    dim3 g((sc*total+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);
         710	    multigrid_full_to_even<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,S>>>(dst, src, sc, X, Y, Z, Lt_full);
         711	    // NOTE: cast to LatticeComplex<T>* so the offset is in COMPLEX elements.
         712	    // Using (T*)src + N (T=float) would advance N FLOATS = half the channel.
         713	    multigrid_full_to_odd<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,S>>>(
         714	        (LatticeComplex<T>*)dst+(size_t)(_LAT_SC_*levels[0].vol), src, sc, X, Y, Z, Lt_full);
         715	  }
         716
         717	  /**
         718	   * @brief Convert parity-split [2, sc, X, Y, Z, T/2] to a full-site vector.
         719	   * dst has size 2*lat_4dim_SC.
         720	   */
         721	  void parity_to_full(void *dst, void *src) {
         722	    cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
         723	    size_t nbytes=2*(size_t)(_LAT_SC_*levels[0].vol)*sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>);
         724	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemsetAsync(dst, 0, nbytes, S));
         725	    int sc=_LAT_SC_, total=(int)levels[0].vol;
         726	    int X=levels[0].X, Y=levels[0].Y, Z=levels[0].Z;
         727	    int Lt_full=2*levels[0].Lt;
         728	    dim3 g((sc*total+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);
         729	    multigrid_even_to_full<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,S>>>(dst, src, sc, X, Y, Z, Lt_full);
         730	    // NOTE: cast to LatticeComplex<T>* so the offset is in COMPLEX elements.
         731	    multigrid_odd_to_full<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,S>>>(
         732	        dst,(LatticeComplex<T>*)src+(size_t)(_LAT_SC_*levels[0].vol), sc, X, Y, Z, Lt_full);
         733	  }
         734
         735	  /**
         736	   * @brief Full-site Clover-Wilson dslash: out = D·in.
         737	   *
         738	   * Decomposes in into even/odd parity, applies the block operator
         739	   *   (D·in)_e = D_ee·in_e - κ·H_eo·in_o
         740	   *   (D·in)_o = D_oo·in_o - κ·H_oe·in_e
         741	   * using the C++ parity-split dslash components, then recombines.
         742	   * Both in/out are full-site vectors [sc, X, Y, Z, T] (2*lat_4dim_SC).
         743	   */
         744	  void fine_full_dslash_op(void *out, void *in) {
         745	    cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
         746	    dim3 gv=set_ptr->gridDim, bv=set_ptr->blockDim;
         747	    size_t ch=(size_t)(_LAT_SC_*levels[0].vol);   // one parity channel size (complex elems)
         748
         749	    // Split input into parity channels: even at parity_tmp[0], odd at +ch.
         750	    full_to_parity(parity_tmp, in);
         751	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         752	    void *xe=parity_tmp;
         753	    void *xo=(LatticeComplex<T>*)parity_tmp+ch;
         754
         755	    // (D·in)_e = D_ee·x_e - κ·H_eo·x_o
         756	    give_copy_vals<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>(set_ptr->device_vec0, xe);
         757	    clover_dslash_ee.give(set_ptr->device_vec0);              // vec0 = D_ee·x_e
         758	    wilson_dslash.run_eo(set_ptr->device_vec1, xo, gauge);    // vec1 = H_eo·x_o
         759	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         760	    LatticeComplex<T> neg_kap(-kappa_val,0);
         761	    CUBLAS_CHECK(_cublasAxpy<T>(set_ptr->cublasH,(int)ch,&neg_kap,
         762	        set_ptr->device_vec1,1,set_ptr->device_vec0,1));      // vec0 -= κ·vec1
         763	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         764	    give_copy_vals<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>(parity_dst, set_ptr->device_vec0);
         765
         766	    // (D·in)_o = D_oo·x_o - κ·H_oe·x_e
         767	    give_copy_vals<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>(set_ptr->device_vec2, xo);
         768	    clover_dslash_oo.give(set_ptr->device_vec2);              // vec2 = D_oo·x_o
         769	    wilson_dslash.run_oe(set_ptr->device_vec0, xe, gauge);    // vec0 = H_oe·x_e
         770	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         771	    CUBLAS_CHECK(_cublasAxpy<T>(set_ptr->cublasH,(int)ch,&neg_kap,
         772	        set_ptr->device_vec0,1,set_ptr->device_vec2,1));      // vec2 -= κ·vec0
         773	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         774	    give_copy_vals<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>((LatticeComplex<T>*)parity_dst+ch, set_ptr->device_vec2);
         775
         776	    // Combine parity → full-site output
         777	    parity_to_full(out, parity_dst);
         778	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         779	  }

         781	  /**
         782	   * @brief Restrict fine full-site → coarse full-site.
         783	   * Both vectors are full-site (non-parity-split).
         784	   */
         785	  void restrict_op(void *co, void *fi, int fl) {
         786	    int l=fl+1, E=levels[l].dof, e=levels[fl].dof;
         787	    int Xf=levels[fl].X,Yf=levels[fl].Y,Zf=levels[fl].Z,Ltf=levels[fl].Lt;
         788	    int Xc=levels[l].X,Yc=levels[l].Y,Zc=levels[l].Z,Ltc=levels[l].Lt;
         789	    int t=E*Xc*Yc*Zc*Ltc; dim3 g((t+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);
         790	    multigrid_restrict<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,set_ptr->stream>>>(
         791	        co,fi,null_vecs[fl],E,e,Xf,Yf,Zf,Ltf,Xc,Yc,Zc,Ltc);
         792	  }
         793
         794	  /**
         795	   * @brief Prolong coarse full-site → fine full-site.
         796	   */
         797	  void prolong_op(void *fo, void *ci, int fl) {
         798	    int l=fl+1, E=levels[l].dof, e=levels[fl].dof;
         799	    int Xf=levels[fl].X,Yf=levels[fl].Y,Zf=levels[fl].Z,Ltf=levels[fl].Lt;
         800	    int Xc=levels[l].X,Yc=levels[l].Y,Zc=levels[l].Z,Ltc=levels[l].Lt;
         801	    int t=e*Xf*Yf*Zf*Ltf; dim3 g((t+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);
         802	    multigrid_prolong<T><<<g,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,set_ptr->stream>>>(
         803	        fo,ci,null_vecs[fl],E,e,Xf,Yf,Zf,Ltf,Xc,Yc,Zc,Ltc);
         804	  }

         810	  /**
         811	   * @brief MPI-parallel dot product for fine-level (level 0) vectors.
         812	   *
         813	   * Computes dot = sum_i conj(a[i]) * b[i] across all MPI ranks.
         814	   * Writes cublasDot result to device_vals[_send_tmp_], copies D→H,
         815	   * runs MPI_Allreduce, then copies H→D to device_vals[vals_idx].
         816	   *
         817	   * CRITICAL: The result is in BOTH host_vals[vals_idx] AND
         818	   * device_vals[vals_idx] after this call returns.
         819	   */
         820	  void dot_mpi(void *a, void *b, int vals_idx, int si) {

## Activity

         820	  void dot_mpi(void *a, void *b, int vals_idx, int si) {
         821	    LatticeComplex<T> *dv=static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(set_ptr->device_vals);
         822	    CUBLAS_CHECK(_cublasDot<T>(set_ptr->cublasHs[si],set_ptr->lat_4dim_SC,
         823	        a,1,b,1,&dv[_send_tmp_]));
         824	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&host_vals[_send_tmp_],&dv[_send_tmp_],
         825	        sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>),cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,set_ptr->streams[si]));
         826	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         827	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[si]));
         828	    _MPI_Allreduce<T>(&host_vals[_send_tmp_],&host_vals[vals_idx],_REAL_IMAG_,
         829	        MPI_SUM,MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         830	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         831	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&dv[vals_idx],&host_vals[vals_idx],
         832	        sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>),cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,set_ptr->streams[si]));
         833	  }

         836	   * @brief MPI-parallel dot product for FULL-site level-0 vectors.
         837	   * Same protocol as dot_mpi but sums over 2*lat_4dim_SC elements
         838	   * (the full-site level-0 vectors have size [sc, X, Y, Z, T]).
         839	   */

         851	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         852	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&dv[vals_idx],&host_vals[vals_idx],

         856	  /**
         857	   * @brief Dot product for coarse-level vectors (single GPU, no MPI).
         858	   *
         859	   * Uses the single-block reduction kernel coarse_dot_kernel (see above)
         860	   * instead of cublasDot — profiling showed the cublas launch + memcpy
         861	   * overhead dominated coarse solves.  Writes device_vals[vals_idx] on-device
         862	   * and mirrors to host_vals only for the convergence check.
         863	   *
         864	   * Multi-rank: the local partial sum is reduced across ranks with
         865	   * MPI_Allreduce (real/imag separately) so every rank sees the global dot.
         866	   */
         867	  void dot_coarse(void *a, void *b, int lv, int vals_idx, int si) {
         868	    auto d0=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         869	    LatticeComplex<T> *dv=static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(set_ptr->device_vals);
         870	    // 2026-08-15 dev76: large coarse vectors (>= 64K elements) use the
         871	    // multi-block grid-stride reduction (single-block serialized ~768 adds
         872	    // per thread at 196608 elements dominated the coarse solve).
         873	    int n = (int)levels[lv].vec_sz;
         874	    if (n >= 65536) {
         875	      int nblk = (n + 255) / 256; if (nblk > 256) nblk = 256;
         876	      coarse_dot_kernel_multi<T, 256><<<nblk, 256, 0, set_ptr->streams[si]>>>(
         877	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(a),
         878	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(b), n,
         879	          static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(coarse_partials));
         880	      coarse_dot_reduce_kernel<T, 256><<<1, 256, 0, set_ptr->streams[si]>>>(
         881	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(coarse_partials), nblk, &dv[vals_idx]);
         882	    } else {
         883	      coarse_dot_kernel<T, 256><<<1, 256, 0, set_ptr->streams[si]>>>(
         884	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(a), static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(b),
         885	          n, &dv[vals_idx]);
         886	    }
         887	    // Mirror to host ONLY for the convergence check (host_vals[_norm2_tmp_]).
         888	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&host_vals[vals_idx], &dv[vals_idx],
         889	        sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, set_ptr->streams[si]));
         890	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[si]));
         891	    if (mg_multi) {
         892	      T gx = host_vals[vals_idx].real(), gy = host_vals[vals_idx].imag();
         893	      MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &gx, 1, mpi_real_type<T>(), MPI_SUM,
         894	                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         895	      MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &gy, 1, mpi_real_type<T>(), MPI_SUM,
         896	                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
         897	      host_vals[vals_idx] = LatticeComplex<T>(gx, gy);
         898	      // Mirror the reduced value back to device_vals — the BiStabCG kernels
         899	      // read the scalars from device memory.
         900	      checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&dv[vals_idx], &host_vals[vals_idx],
         901	          sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
         902	          set_ptr->streams[si]));
         903	      checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[si]));
         904	    }
         905	    auto d1=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         906	    prof_coarse_dot_ms += std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(d1-d0).count();
         907	  }

         909	  // ---- Vector helpers ----
         910	  void zero_c(void *v,int l) {
         911	    checkCudaErrors(cudaMemsetAsync(v,0,levels[l].vec_sz*sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>),set_ptr->stream));
         912	  }
         913	  // Helper: grid dimensions for site-processing kernels (each thread = 1 site × all DOF).
         914	  // The BiStabCG kernels (give_copy_vals, bistabcg_give_*) process _LAT_SC_ elements
         915	  // per thread, so the number of threads must be (effective vec_sz)/_LAT_SC_
         916	  // (NOT levels[lev].vol, which is the site count for 12-DOF vectors only).  This makes
         917	  // the infrastructure correct for coarse levels with E != 12 (e.g. dof_list=[12,24,...])
         918	  // and for the full-site level 0 (whose vectors are 2× the per-channel vec_sz).
         919	  dim3 site_grid(int lev) {
         920	    size_t eff = levels[lev].is_fullsite ? 2*levels[lev].vec_sz : levels[lev].vec_sz;
         921	    int t=(int)(eff / _LAT_SC_);
         922	    return dim3((t+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);
         923	  }
         924	  void copy_c(void *d,void *s,int l) {
         925	    give_copy_vals<T><<<site_grid(l),_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,set_ptr->stream>>>(d,s);
         926	  }

         928	  // ==================================================================
         929	  // dev84: coarse-level dot into a device_vals slot — NO host sync.
         930	  // Shared by bistabcg_iter_coarse() and coarse_resid_norm().  Multi-block
         931	  // path for n ≥ 65536 (dev76), single-block otherwise.  In the redundant-
         932	  // global multi-rank model all ranks compute bitwise-identical partials
         933	  // (replicated data, deterministic kernels), so no MPI Allreduce is needed
         934	  // here — matching the existing iteration semantics.
         935	  // ==================================================================
         936	  void coarse_dot_slot(int lev, const LatticeComplex<T>* a,
         937	                       const LatticeComplex<T>* b, int slot) {
         938	    coarse_dot_dest(lev, a, b,
         939	        &static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(set_ptr->device_vals)[slot]);
         940	  }
         941
         942	  // dev84: same dot with an EXPLICIT destination — used to write results into
         943	  // zero-copy mapped host memory (bypasses cudaMemcpyAsync D2H entirely; on
         944	  // this WSL2 box each D2H memcpyAsync enqueue costs ~40 ms!).
         945	  void coarse_dot_dest(int lev, const LatticeComplex<T>* a,
         946	                       const LatticeComplex<T>* b, LatticeComplex<T>* dest) {
         947	    cudaStream_t S = set_ptr->stream;
         948	    const int n = (int)levels[lev].vec_sz;
         949	    // dev84: SINGLE-BLOCK dot for everything below ~1M elements.  On this box
         950	    // each kernel execution costs ~300 µs GPU-side regardless of work, so the
         951	    // 2-kernel multi-block path (partials + reduce) always loses to one
         952	    // 1-block grid-stride kernel (~125 µs of memory traffic at n=294912).
         953	    if (n >= 1048576) {
         954	      int nblk = (n + 255) / 256; if (nblk > 256) nblk = 256;
         955	      coarse_dot_kernel_multi<T, 256><<<nblk, 256, 0, S>>>(
         956	          a, b, n, static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(coarse_partials));
         957	      coarse_dot_reduce_kernel<T, 256><<<1, 256, 0, S>>>(
         958	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(coarse_partials), nblk, dest);
         959	    } else {
         960	      coarse_dot_kernel<T, 256><<<1, 256, 0, S>>>(a, b, n, dest);
         961	    }
         962	  }

         964	  // Host-visible ||r|| at a coarse level: ONE dot + ONE D2H + ONE sync.
         965	  // Used by the block-checked coarse solve loop (every check_every iters).
         966	  T coarse_resid_norm(int lev) {
         967	    auto &st = levels[lev];
         968	    cudaStream_t S = set_ptr->stream;
         969	    auto k0=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         970	    coarse_dot_dest(lev, static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r),
         971	                    static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r),
         972	                    static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(check_dev));
         973	    auto k1=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         974	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
         975	    auto k2=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
         976	    prof_ck_kernel_ms += std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(k1-k0).count();
         977	    prof_ck_sync_ms += std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(k2-k1).count();
         978	    T g = check_host[0].real();
         979	    return sqrt(g < (T)0 ? (T)0 : g);
         980	  }

         983	  // ==================================================================
         984	  // BiStabCG iteration — EXACT sync pattern of BistabCg::_run()
         985	  //
         986	  // Convergence residual (||r||²) is written to host_vals[_norm2_tmp_]
         987	  // during step 3.5 (before dslash). The caller checks it after the
         988	  // iteration to decide convergence. This is intentionally lagged by
         989	  // one iteration, matching the reference BiStabCG behavior.
         990	  //
         991	  // FIX: Full stream sync at end of iteration to ensure all device_vals
         992	  // updates are visible before the next iteration reads them.
         993	  // ==================================================================
         994	  /**
         995	   * @brief Single-stream, overhead-light BiStabCG iteration for COARSE levels.
         996	   *
         997	   * Coarse vectors are tiny (a few thousand complex elements), so the 5-stream
         998	   * parallel dot architecture used at the fine level is pure overhead: it
         999	   * performs ~4 cublasDot + 4 memcpy + ~10 stream syncs per iteration, which
        1000	   * dominated the coarse solve (profiling: dots = 416 ms, vector kernels =
        1001	   * ~445 ms of a 2 s solve).  This version:
        1002	   *   - uses a single stream (serialised kernels — tiny anyway),
        1003	   *   - computes every dot with the single-block reduction kernel writing
        1004	   *     directly into device_vals (no cublas, no per-dot memcpy),
        1005	   *   - mirrors the convergence norm to host only ONCE per iteration.
        1006	   * Semantics match the standard BiStabCG exactly (r_tilde, p/v/s/t, scalars).
        1007	   *
        1008	   * dev84: with_norm=false skips step 10 entirely (no ||r||² dot, no D2H, no
        1009	   * sync) — the caller then checks the residual every `check_every` iterations
        1010	   * via coarse_resid_norm() instead of every iteration.  On 16x32x32x48 the
        1011	   * coarse solve is ~100 iterations × ~1.3 ms of pure host-sync latency; block
        1012	   * checking removes ≥7/8 of that sync cost while keeping the breakdown guard.
        1013	   */
        1014	  void bistabcg_iter_coarse(int lev, bool with_norm = true) {
        1015	    auto &st=levels[lev]; cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
        1016	    LatticeComplex<T> *dv=static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1017	    dim3 gv=site_grid(lev), bv=dim3(_BLOCK_SIZE_);
        1018	    const LatticeComplex<T>* rt = static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r_tilde);
        1019	    const LatticeComplex<T>* r  = static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r);
        1020	    auto tc0=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        1021	    // 2026-08-15 dev76: multi-block dot for large coarse vectors
        1022	    // (single-block serial reduction dominated the coarse solve on
        1023	    //  16x16x16x32 lv1 = 196608 elements).
        1024	    // dev84: shared by coarse_resid_norm() via coarse_dot_slot().
        1025	    auto cdot = [&](const LatticeComplex<T>* a, const LatticeComplex<T>* b,
        1026	                    int slot) { coarse_dot_slot(lev, a, b, slot); };
        1027
        1028	    // 1. rho = <r_tilde, r>
        1029	    cdot(rt, r, _rho_);
        1030	    // 2. beta = (rho/rho_prev)*(alpha/omega);  rho_prev = rho
        1031	    //    dev84: GUARDED variants — post-convergence ρ→0 breakdown clamped to
        1032	    //    β=0 instead of 0/0 NaN (fixed-step sync-free loop never checks host).
        1033	    //    dev84 kernel-count diet: β+ρ_prev fused into one launch.
        1034	    mg_give_1beta_rp<T><<<1,1,0,S>>>(dv);
        1035	    // 3. p = r + beta*(p - omega*v)
        1036	    bistabcg_give_p<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>(st.p, st.r, st.v, dv);
        1037	    // 4. v = A_c·p
        1038	    coarse_dslash_op(st.v, st.p, lev);
        1039	    // 5. alpha = rho / <r_tilde, v>
        1040	    cdot(rt, static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.v), _tmp0_);
        1041	    mg_give_1alpha<T><<<1,1,0,S>>>(dv);
        1042	    // 6. s = r - alpha*v
        1043	    bistabcg_give_s<T><<<gv,bv,0,S>>>(st.s, st.r, st.v, dv);
        1044	    // 7. t = A_c·s
        1045	    coarse_dslash_op(st.t, st.s, lev);
        1046	    // 8. omega = <t,s>/<t,t>
        1047	    cdot(static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.t),
        1048	         static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.s), _tmp0_);
        1049	    cdot(static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.t),
        1050	         static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.t), _tmp1_);
        1051	    mg_give_1omega<T><<<1,1,0,S>>>(dv);
        1052	    // 9. r = s - omega*t;  x = x + alpha*p + omega*s
        1053	    //    dev84 kernel-count diet: both elementwise updates fused (one launch).
        1054	    {
        1055	      size_t eff = st.vec_sz;   // coarse levels: vec_sz/_LAT_SC_ site groups
        1056	      int t4 = (int)(eff / _LAT_SC_);
        1057	      mg_give_rx<T><<<(t4+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_,_BLOCK_SIZE_,0,S>>>(
        1058	          static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r),
        1059	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.s),
        1060	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.t),
        1061	          static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.x),
        1062	          static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.p), dv, t4);
        1063	    }
        1064	    // 10. convergence norm ||r||² -> host (once per iteration, or never when
        1065	    //     with_norm=false — the caller block-checks via coarse_resid_norm())
        1066	    if (with_norm) {
        1067	      cdot(static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r),
        1068	           static_cast<const LatticeComplex<T>*>(st.r), _norm2_tmp_);
        1069	      checkCudaErrors(cudaMemcpyAsync(&host_vals[_norm2_tmp_], &dv[_norm2_tmp_],
        1070	          sizeof(LatticeComplex<T>), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, S));
        1071	      checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1072	    }
        1073	    // NOTE: the per-iteration cost here is dominated by the host sync above
        1074	    // (~170 us) plus the ~14 tiny kernel launches — NOT by the wide dslash
        1075	    // (prof_coarse_dslash_ms stays < 1 ms across the whole solve).
        1076	    auto tc1=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        1077	    prof_coarse_vec_ms += std::chrono::duration<double,std::milli>(tc1-tc0).count();
        1078	  }

        1080	  void bistabcg_iter(int lev, bool host_sync=true) {
        1081	    // Coarse levels use the single-stream overhead-light path.
        1082	    if (lev >= 1) { bistabcg_iter_coarse(lev); return; }
        1083	    // Single-rank fine level: use the sync-light single-stream path
        1084	    // (cublasDot directly into device_vals on the main stream, ONE sync per
        1085	    // iteration instead of ~20).  Multi-rank keeps the 5-stream MPI path.
        1086	    if (set_ptr->host_params[_GRID_X_] == 1 &&
        1087	        set_ptr->host_params[_GRID_Y_] == 1 &&
        1088	        set_ptr->host_params[_GRID_Z_] == 1 &&
        1089	        set_ptr->host_params[_GRID_T_] == 1 &&
        1090	        !_WILSON_AND_LAPLACIAN_TEST_SINGLE_IN_MULTI_) {
        1091	      bistabcg_iter_fine_fast();
        1092	      return;
        1093	    }
        1094	    auto &st=levels[lev];
        1095	    bool fine=(lev==0); cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
        1096	    // fullsite: level 0 solved on FULL-site vectors (support_parity=False style).
        1097	    // In this mode the vectors have size 2*lat_4dim_SC and _lat_4dim_ must be
        1098	    // patched (by the caller) to the full-site volume 2*st.vol.
        1099	    bool fullsite=(fine && st.is_fullsite);
        1100	    dim3 gv,bv;
        1101	    // Grid dimension: number of SITES (vol), not total elements (vec_sz = dof*vol).
        1102	    // Each thread processes one site × all DOF components.
        1103	    // Using vec_sz would launch vol*dof threads, causing OOB writes.
        1104	    if(fine && !fullsite){gv=set_ptr->gridDim;bv=set_ptr->blockDim;}
        1105	    else{
        1106	      // Number of threads = (effective vec_sz)/_LAT_SC_ so that the kernels
        1107	      // (which process _LAT_SC_ elements per thread) cover the ENTIRE vector.
        1108	      // The full-site level 0 has 2*st.vec_sz elements; coarse levels may have
        1109	      // E != 12 (e.g. dof_list=[12,24,...]) so their vec_sz/12 is used.
        1110	      size_t eff = fullsite ? 2*st.vec_sz : st.vec_sz;
        1111	      int t=(int)(eff / _LAT_SC_);
        1112	      gv=dim3((t+_BLOCK_SIZE_-1)/_BLOCK_SIZE_);bv=dim3(_BLOCK_SIZE_);
        1113	    }
        1114
        1115	    // Step 1: ρ = (r_tilde, r)           [stream _a_]
        1116	    auto tp0=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        1117	    if(fine){
        1118	      if(fullsite) dot_full_mpi(st.r_tilde,st.r,_rho_,_a_);
        1119	      else         dot_mpi(st.r_tilde,st.r,_rho_,_a_);
        1120	    }
        1121	    else dot_coarse(st.r_tilde,st.r,lev,_rho_,_a_);
        1122	    auto tp1=std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        1123	    double dt_dot1=std::chrono::duration<double,std::micro>(tp1-tp0).count();
        1124
        1125	    // Step 2: β=(ρ/ρ_prev)*(α/ω)          [_a_];  ρ_prev←ρ [_b_]
        1126	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_b_]));
        1127	    bistabcg_give_1beta<T><<<1,1,0,set_ptr->streams[_a_]>>>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1128	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_a_]));
        1129	    bistabcg_give_1rho_prev<T><<<1,1,0,set_ptr->streams[_b_]>>>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1130
        1131	    // Step 3: p = r + β·(p−ω·v)          [_a_]
        1132	    bistabcg_give_p<T><<<gv,bv,0,set_ptr->streams[_a_]>>>(st.p,st.r,st.v,set_ptr->device_vals);
        1133	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_a_]));
        1134
        1135	    // Step 3.5: convergence check — ||r||² → host_vals[_norm2_tmp_]  [_c_]
        1136	    // Placed here (before dslash) matching the reference BiStabCG exactly.
        1137	    if(fine){ if(fullsite) dot_full_mpi(st.r,st.r,_norm2_tmp_,_c_);
        1138	              else         dot_mpi(st.r,st.r,_norm2_tmp_,_c_); }
        1139	    else     dot_coarse(st.r,st.r,lev,_norm2_tmp_,_c_);
        1140
        1141	    // Step 4: v = A·p                      [main stream]
        1142	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1143	    if(fine){ if(fullsite) fine_full_dslash_op(st.v,st.p); else fine_dslash_op(st.v,st.p); }
        1144	    else     coarse_dslash_op(st.v,st.p,lev);
        1145	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1146
        1147	    // Step 5: τ₀=(r_tilde,v); α=ρ/τ₀     [_d_]
        1148	    if(fine){ if(fullsite) dot_full_mpi(st.r_tilde,st.v,_tmp0_,_d_);
        1149	              else         dot_mpi(st.r_tilde,st.v,_tmp0_,_d_); }
        1150	    else     dot_coarse(st.r_tilde,st.v,lev,_tmp0_,_d_);
        1151	    bistabcg_give_1alpha<T><<<1,1,0,set_ptr->streams[_d_]>>>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1152	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_d_]));
        1153
        1154	    // Step 6: s = r − α·v                  [_a_]
        1155	    bistabcg_give_s<T><<<gv,bv,0,set_ptr->streams[_a_]>>>(st.s,st.r,st.v,set_ptr->device_vals);
        1156	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_a_]));
        1157
        1158	    // Step 7: t = A·s                      [main stream]
        1159	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1160	    if(fine){ if(fullsite) fine_full_dslash_op(st.t,st.s); else fine_dslash_op(st.t,st.s); }
        1161	    else     coarse_dslash_op(st.t,st.s,lev);
        1162	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1163
        1164	    // Step 8: τ₀=(t,s); τ₁=(t,t)          [_c_],[_d_]
        1165	    if(fine){ if(fullsite){dot_full_mpi(st.t,st.s,_tmp0_,_c_);dot_full_mpi(st.t,st.t,_tmp1_,_d_);}
        1166	              else        {dot_mpi(st.t,st.s,_tmp0_,_c_);dot_mpi(st.t,st.t,_tmp1_,_d_);} }
        1167	    else    {dot_coarse(st.t,st.s,lev,_tmp0_,_c_);dot_coarse(st.t,st.t,lev,_tmp1_,_d_);}
        1168	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_c_]));
        1169
        1170	    // Step 9: ω = τ₀/τ₁                   [_d_]
        1171	    bistabcg_give_1omega<T><<<1,1,0,set_ptr->streams[_d_]>>>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1172	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_d_]));
        1173
        1174	    // Step 10: r=s−ω·t [_a_];  x=x+α·p+ω·s [_b_]
        1175	    bistabcg_give_r<T><<<gv,bv,0,set_ptr->streams[_a_]>>>(st.r,st.s,st.t,set_ptr->device_vals);
        1176	    bistabcg_give_x_o<T><<<gv,bv,0,set_ptr->streams[_b_]>>>(st.x,st.p,st.s,set_ptr->device_vals);
        1177
        1178	    // Full 5-stream sync at bottom of iteration — REQUIRED for deterministic
        1179	    // convergence.  Reducing to only _a_/_c_ kept a race (iteration count
        1180	    // 70, 70, 78 across runs vs a stable 63-68 with the full sync).
        1181	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(S));
        1182	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_a_]));
        1183	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_b_]));
        1184	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_c_]));
        1185	    checkCudaErrors(cudaStreamSynchronize(set_ptr->streams[_d_]));
        1186	  }

        1189	  // Single-rank, single-stream, sync-light BiStabCG iteration (level 0).
        1190	  //
        1191	  // WHY (2026-08-02): the reference 5-stream iteration (bistabcg_iter)
        1192	  // costs ~6 ms/iter on this WSL2/V100 box because every dot performs
        1193	  //   cublasDot -> D2H memcpy -> MPI_Barrier -> cudaStreamSynchronize
        1194	  //   (~170 us each) -> MPI_Allreduce -> H2D memcpy,
        1195	  // and there are ~20 such syncs per iteration.  For a 1x1x1x1 process
        1196	  // grid MPI_Allreduce is the identity, so we write each dot straight into
        1197	  // device_vals on the MAIN stream (cublasH is bound to set_ptr->stream).
        1198	  // In-stream ordering makes every consumer kernel see the result; we sync
        1199	  // ONCE at the end so host_vals[_norm2_tmp_] holds the convergence
        1200	  // residual.  Mathematically identical to bistabcg_iter, ~20x fewer syncs.

        1204	  void bistabcg_iter_fine_fast(bool host_sync=true) {
        1205	    auto &st=levels[0]; cudaStream_t S=set_ptr->stream;
        1206	    LatticeComplex<T>* dv=static_cast<LatticeComplex<T>*>(set_ptr->device_vals);
        1207	    dim3 gv=set_ptr->gridDim, bv=set_ptr->blockDim;
        1208	    const int n=(int)st.vec_sz;  // = lat_4dim_SC elements (odd-site vector)
        1209	    // The dslash outputs (st.v / st.t) are consumed by the NEXT kernel on the
        1210	    // same main stream, so run_mpi's final sync is redundant — save ~340 us/iter.

        2024	  // Main solve — FULL-operator BiStabCG at level 0 with V-cycle corrections.
        2025	  //
        2026	  // This matches pyqcu/solver/_multigrid.py with support_parity=False:

        2028	  //     vectors [sc, X, Y, Z, T]  (NOT the even-odd preconditioned Schur
        2029	  //     complement — the coarse space captures the low modes of D much better
        2030	  //     than those of the Schur-complement operator, so the V-cycle correction
        2031	  //     actually reduces the iteration count).

        2035	  // ==================================================================
        2036	  // ==================================================================
        2037	  // Main solve — SCHUR (parity-preconditioned) level-0 BiStabCG with
        2038	  // recursive V-cycle coarse corrections.
        2039	  //
        2040	  // Solves  S·x_o = b__o  where  S = D_oo - k^2·H_oe·D_ee^{-1}·H_eo
        2041	  // and     b__o = b_o + k·H_oe·D_ee^{-1}·b_e.

        2049	  // A_c = P^T S P (33-tensor stencil), prolong, add to x_o, recompute the
        2050	  // Schur residual, and reset the BiStabCG state.
